runners.name: Del Maro
runners.spotlight: Acts on good to firm, as he showed again when he finished strongest to be pipped in 1m6f Group 2 at Royal Ascot three weeks ago (Point Of Law a close fourth, Galiyan sixth); that was the second race in succession in which he's been beaten a nose, and his sole win from eight races came at odds-on (from newcomer Point Of Law) in a novice, but his form is on an upward curve and he brings proven stamina; looks set for another big shout.
runners.comment: Beaten a nose in last two of his eight races; latest was 1m6f Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Alderman
runners.spotlight: A promising, scopey sort from a famous middle-distance family; progressive form in maidens, without a win, prior to his huge run at 100-1 in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft) nearly five weeks ago when he came from towards rear to finish about 7l fifth of 14; kept on well at the finish, as if this longer trip will suit; faces very different ground today (he's unraced on firmer than good) but he's a big player if that is not a problem.
runners.comment: Came from towards rear to finish about 7l fifth of 14 in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft)

runners.name: Galiyan
runners.spotlight: Kept finding for pressure in a maiden at Chester (1m4f, good) in May on second start and asserted in good style late on; that saw him sent off 2-1 favourite for the Group 2 Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) three weeks ago in which he raced at least three horses wide before keeping on to be 3l sixth of 11; could still be open to improvement but Del Maro and Point Of Law went past him from over 1f out last time.
runners.comment: 2-1 when 3l sixth in Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot (1m6f) with two of today's rivals ahead

runners.name: Nil Bua Gan Dua
runners.spotlight: Pitched into Group events twice as 2yo and it wasn't until his second start this term that he got off the mark (made all over 10.4f at Roscommon); 22-1, every chance through the final 2f when an excellent fourth of 16 on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) 19 days ago; longer trips than that now look well worth a go but he has the most to prove in this field, including with a bit to find on form.
runners.comment: Fourth in 1m2f handicap at Royal Ascot and further than that looks well worth a go
runners.owner: A K Whelan & Reeves Thoroughbred Racing

runners.name: Point Of Law
runners.spotlight: Debut saw him give odds-on Del Maro something to think about in a Yarmouth novice; went one better at 4-7 himself in a Newbury maiden (again 1m2f on good) in May but it was the Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) which confirmed him as a serious prospect, as he was hampered on the first turn but finished almost as strongly as Del Maro to end up on heels of the leaders; still looked a work in progress and should be firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Finished almost as strongly as Del Maro to end up on heels of the leaders at Royal Ascot
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

races.race_name: Kingdom Of Bahrain July Stakes (Group 2) (Colts & Geldings)

runners.name: Adaay Of Scarlett
runners.spotlight: Won his first two starts (5f, good/good to firm) before Listed second at Sandown (5f, good), and he showed improved form on his first crack at 6f when going close at 40-1 in the Group 2 Coventry at Royal Ascot (good to firm) last month; he has the best form in the field.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the Coventry at Royal Ascot and has the best form in the field

runners.name: Inner City Blues
runners.spotlight: 900,000euros breeze-up buy who was sent off the well-backed 4-9 favourite when winning on last month's debut at York (6f, good); that 2l win was a performance packed with promise, and the second and third have won since; has a Group 1 entry; exciting prospect for his powerful connections.
runners.comment: 900,000euros breeze-up buy; won on York debut; exciting prospect for powerful connections

runners.name: Hickory Lad
runners.spotlight: Ran over 5f (good) on first three starts, with two good seconds sandwiching a win at Musselburgh, and he took a step forward on his first attempt at 6f when making all in the Woodcote at Epsom (good to soft) last month; this is a much tougher test of his credentials but he did it easily last time and could make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Easily made all in the Woodcote at Epsom; this is tougher but could make another bold bid

runners.name: Persian Spring
runners.spotlight: Won big-field novice at York's Dante meeting in May on his second start (6f, good) and he suffered interference when well beaten in the Group 2 Norfolk at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm); the return to 6f could be a positive and his stable has an excellent record in this race, but other runners have more substance to their claims.
runners.comment: Won York novice then well beaten at Royal Ascot; others have more substance to claims

runners.name: Ghost Mode
runners.spotlight: Emphatic winner of handicap debut on Southwell AW (6f) in March; found Group 3 and Listed races too daunting on next two starts and he made only modest late headway into mid-division over 5f at Royal Ascot (40-1; without regular hood, as today); return to 6f should suit but the same applies to others from that race.
runners.comment: Emphatic winner of handicap debut (6f, AW); never involved over 5f at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Man Of Vision
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in 7f AW novice in December; strong start to handicap career when runner-up to Ten Carat Harry on the other course here (6f, good to firm) in May but York's sharper test in June didn't look ideal when beaten about 5l behind Thunder Call; may well do better today.
runners.comment: Strong start to handicap career in May; sharp 6f may not have suited at York since

runners.name: Thunder Call
runners.spotlight: Came on plenty over the winter, easily winning a 6f Kempton AW maiden on comeback, then saw off a big field on handicap debut at York (6f, good) in June; he ended with a little up his sleeve at York and a 6lb rise isn't harsh for one who can improve further for this stiffer test at the trip.
runners.comment: Won a shade cosily on 6f handicap debut at York; up 6lb; can improve for this stiffer test

runners.name: Calico Blue
runners.spotlight: Juvenile wins came in 6f novices; has held his own in 5f handicaps this year, doing well on the far side when fourth of 27 at Royal Ascot (good to firm) just behind Ten Carat Harry; return to 6f can suit; better claims than most.
runners.comment: Up-and-coming 3yo; solid 5f form, including at Royal Ascot; return to 6f can suit

runners.name: Mo Of Cairo
runners.spotlight: His 2yo career ended with a close second in a big-field York handicap (6f, good to firm; River Spey a hampered fourth) but this year's form, including at Windsor last time, leaves him with something to find.
runners.comment: Close second in 6f handicap on final 2yo start; has more to prove on this year's form

runners.name: Sea Cookie
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 for the year when finding plenty to win on handicap debut over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago, albeit with the next two home not obviously well treated; has potential but more is needed off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Found plenty for handicap debut win over C&D in June; up 5lb in a much stronger race

runners.name: Ten Carat Harry
runners.spotlight: Has given superb value since the autumn, winning five 6f handicaps on the AW between October and January; even better in turf sprints since, landing a 6f handicap on the Rowley course here (good to firm) and finishing strongly to take second on his side to a handicap blot in the big 5f race at Royal Ascot; rock solid to go well back at 6f.
runners.comment: Five AW handicap wins but even better in turf sprints since; can go well back at 6f

runners.name: Starmade
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on the AW, at 5f and 6f; his first turf handicap run, at Bath in April, was nothing to get excited about but he showed he belonged at this level when a never-nearer fifth of 27 at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) in June; a big run back at 6f could be on the way.
runners.comment: 2-2 on AW; never-nearer 5th at Ascot (5f) in June; return to 6f can suit

runners.name: Red Spells Danger
runners.spotlight: Has made serious progress since dropped to 6f, following an easy maiden win with an impressive handicap debut at Hamilton; ran off 10lb higher in a better York race (good) in June and he did really well to be a close second to Thunder Call who was slightly better positioned; upped another 4lb but closely matched with the winner; on the premises.
runners.comment: Serious progress at 6f; closely matched with Thunder Call on latest York form; thereabouts

runners.name: River Spey
runners.spotlight: Well-connected gelding; justified short odds in 6f AW maiden as 2yo; made a fairly ordinary reappearance but he was much better for it when winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in early June, coming through to beat a useful type at this level; up 4lb but can achieve more.
runners.comment: Low key on return; likeable effort to beat useful type at Windsor (6f); can do better

runners.name: May Angel
runners.spotlight: Creditable shows in 7f turf handicaps this year and the drop to 5f at Royal Ascot since (tongue tied first time) was always going to ask a searching question; however, he did as well as could have been expected in eighth of 27 and this extra furlong can only help; likely more needed from him, even so.
runners.comment: Most runs over 7f; creditable 8th of 27 when dropped to 5f at Ascot; this trip can suit

runners.name: Jazl
runners.spotlight: Looked smart when making short work of his rivals in first two starts as a 3yo in a Windsor maiden and on handicap debut at Leicester (both 6f on good to firm); a 10lb rise for the latter didn't look to be overdoing it but he was badly out of sorts when last of 27 in the big 5f handicap at Royal Ascot since (13-2); trust suspended for now.
runners.comment: Smart over 6f but ran poorly when last of 27 at Royal Ascot (5f; 13-2); trust suspended

runners.name: Pilu
runners.spotlight: Often leads; encouraging return on the other Newmarket course but, despite being well supported, no match for Jazl at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May; has work to do off 2lb higher in a race that will take more winning.
runners.comment: Encouraging comeback; no match for Jazl at Leicester (6f) in May; up 2lb; work to do

races.race_name: Princess Of Wales's Stakes (Sponsored By The Kingdom Of Bahrain) (Group 2)

runners.name: Convergent
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in the mud in his Group 1 attempts last November and last month, latterly in the Coronation Cup at Epsom; progressive otherwise, including two Group wins last autumn and another at Newbury (1m4f, good; Tenability a close third) this April; that Newbury performance makes him a serious contender on form but he's not raced on ground firmer than good.
runners.comment: Newbury win (1m4f, good) makes him serious contender on form; unraced on firmer than good

runners.name: Almeric
runners.spotlight: Three wins from his first four starts, with a soft-ground Listed success at Ayr (1m2f) last September standing out in form terms; respectable third to top-class Ombudsman at Sandown six weeks ago was easily the best of three runs since, all at 1m2f on good ground (unraced on firmer); he needs to return to peak form and to stay a new trip, so others look far more solid.
runners.comment: Unraced on ground firmer than good; needs to return to peak form and to stay a new trip

runners.name: Tenability
runners.spotlight: Won a novice and three Ascot 1m4f handicaps on varied ground last June-September; reappeared with a close third to Convergent in Newbury Group 3 (1m4f, good) in April and prevailed by a neck against veteran stablemate Hamish in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m4f, soft) last month; last year's second Ascot handicap was on good to firm, with markedly better form since; he's a progressive sort but needs to raise his game again.
runners.comment: Won on good to firm once last term; progressive sort but he needs to raise his game again

runners.name: Rebel's Romance
runners.spotlight: Tremendous international performer who has won 21 of 31 races, amassing more than £12m in prize-money; two of last year's winning highlights were over 1m4f on fast ground at Royal Ascot and in the USA, and he was an odds-on scorer at Meydan in February on his only start this term; highly reliable too, so he looks hard to beat despite conceding 3lb all round.
runners.comment: International star; two of last year's winning highlights were over 1m4f on fast ground

runners.name: Arabian Crown
runners.spotlight: Missed most of 2024 and a narrow Listed win at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last August was the only time that he's recaptured his best; even that isn't nearly enough to win this and he trailed in last behind Tenability on reappearance at Goodwood last month; stablemate of Rebel's Romance and might make the running.
runners.comment: Even his best isn't nearly enough to win this; might make the running

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Scommessa Sicura
runners.spotlight: Second at Yarmouth (6f), Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) and Newmarket (7f) in all three starts; made the running last time when beaten by a neck but finishing ahead of Carpe Portus (by nearly 10l) and Lady Miranda; sets a clear standard.
runners.comment: 2nd all three starts; beaten by a neck over C&D latest, nearly 10l ahead of Carpe Portus

runners.name: Peaceful Charm
runners.spotlight: Group 1 Moyglare Stud entry by Dubawi; 2,000,000euros yearling; third foal; sister to French 10.5f-1m4f winner Parachutiste (including Listed; RPR 115), closely related to Group-placed 1m winner Skydance (98); dam 1m4f-1m7f winner (including Group 3; 104); trainer won five of the last nine runnings of this race, three with newcomers including in 2024 with subsequent 1,000 Guineas winner Desert Flower.
runners.comment: Group 1 Moyglare Stud entry by Dubawi; 2,000,000euros yearling; yard does well in this

runners.name: Tall Trees
runners.spotlight: Group 1 Moyglare Stud entry; green on debut but made some good late headway on both starts, in the latter when eighth of 25 in the Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm; 100-1) and that was despite being switched across to the stands' side from her low draw and seeing daylight only when it was far too late; serious contender granted a clear shot at it this time.
runners.comment: Good late headway both starts, latterly when eighth of 25 in Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Tegernsee
runners.spotlight: 180,000gns breeze-up 2yo by St Mark's Basilica; third foal; half-sister to 5f turf 2yo/6f AW winner Sensorium (RPR 83); dam 5f AW 2yo winner (93), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Mind Of Madness and useful 1m-1m4f winner Star Harbour, out of useful 5f winner; the yard's 2yos have done well this term and she needs a market check.
runners.comment: 180,000gns breeze-up 2yo by St Mark's Basilica; needs a market check

runners.name: Madam Secretary
runners.spotlight: Group 1 Moyglare Stud entry, by Wootton Bassett; sister to 7f 2yo winner Amadeus Mozart (RPR 105 over 1m2f this year); weak 6-1 shot and claimer ridden when 5l third of eight in a maiden at Listowel (6.2f, good) in May, looking green and never a serious threat to two pretty useful principals; should know a lot more about it this time and, all in all, could be a big improver for top connections.
runners.comment: Group 1 Moyglare Stud entry; green 3rd of eight in maiden at Listowel (6.2f, good) in May
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Sexy Chick
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling by Havana Grey; 7-2 outsider of three and came from last when runner-up in a novice here (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago, with all of them newcomers and there were just two necks between them; that was a promising introduction.
runners.comment: Second in a tight finish to three-runner novice here (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago

runners.name: Lady Miranda
runners.spotlight: 25-1, slowly away and always behind in C&D novice (good) three weeks ago, finishing well behind Scommessa Sicura and Carpe Portus.
runners.comment: 25-1, slowly away, always behind in C&D novice (good) on debut, well behind two of these

runners.name: Chartwell Rose
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling by Churchill; second foal; dam French Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (RPR 106), half-sister to French 1m/10.5f winner Antolya, out of 1m-winning half-sister to a useful 1m-10.5f winner; late foal and her trainer's record also suggests she is probably one for later on.
runners.comment: 30,000euros yearling by Churchill; late foal; probably one for later on from this yard

runners.name: Blue Sign
runners.spotlight: Group 2 Lowther entry; never figured on good to firm in a novice at Lingfield (5f; 16-1) or Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot (6f; 250-1); didn't get a clear run when 17th of 25 in the latter and is capable of better, but others in this have clearly accomplished more, including Albany eighth Tall Trees.
runners.comment: 250-1, didn't get clear run when 17th of 25 at Royal Ascot but Tall Trees finished eighth

runners.name: Carpe Portus
runners.spotlight: 20-1 when fourth of nine in a novice over C&D (good) three weeks ago, which she should build on but she was nearly 10l behind Scommessa Sicura, so this renewal of rivalry demands a huge leap forward.
runners.comment: 20-1 fourth of nine over C&D three weeks ago but nearly 10l behind Scommessa Sicura

races.race_name: Edmondson Hall Solicitors Sir Henry Cecil Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Morris Dancer
runners.spotlight: Went very close in the Group 2 Vintage at Goodwood (7f, good) last July and easily won four-runner Listed race at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) the following month; then absent until Royal Ascot last month when he kept on for third of 16 in the Group 3 Jersey (7f, good to firm); the return to 1m seems a likely plus and he's a leading candidate under William Buick.
runners.comment: Kept on for 3rd on comeback in the Jersey; return to 1m seems likely plus; leading player

runners.name: Wild Desert
runners.spotlight: Raced four times last year, finishing third in the Group 2 Superlative at this meeting (7f, good to firm) and going close in a Canadian Grade 1 (1m, firm) in September; this is his first run since and William Buick rides Morris Dancer, but it will be no surprise to see a big performance.
runners.comment: Went close in Canadian Grade 1 last September; off since but no surprise to see a big run

runners.name: Colori Forever
runners.spotlight: All seven races at 7f; progressive in handicaps in the spring and made it 2-3 for the year when doing it readily at Ascot (good) in May; down the field in the Group 3 Jersey at the Royal meeting (good to firm; third of seven in the near-side group) but he's better than that and is not ruled out in view of his previous promise, especially as the step up to 1m could suit.
runners.comment: Down the field in the Jersey but progressive in handicaps previously and not ruled out

runners.name: Conclave
runners.spotlight: Made debut in March and posted two wins (1m, AW/good) from his first three starts before a creditable sixth of 30 on handicap debut in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm); further improvement is possible but necessary if he's to come out on top today.
runners.comment: Creditable sixth of 30 in the Britannia; further improvement is possible but necessary

runners.name: Oxagon
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 3 Craven on the Rowley Mile here in April (1m, good) in first-time cheekpieces; soundly beaten in Group 1s on next two starts and same outcome in Group 3 Hampton Court at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); blinkers replace the cheekpieces and the drop back in trip could help; in with a chance on his best form, even under a 5lb penalty, but has to get back on track.
runners.comment: Won the Craven in April but soundly beaten on his three starts since; carries 5lb penalty

runners.name: Lyneham
runners.spotlight: French challenger; won last autumn on first two starts (1m, soft); reappeared with seventh of eight in Group 3 at Longchamp (1m, good) then kept on for a fairly encouraging Listed fifth there (7f, very soft) last time, but others have considerably more substance to their claims.
runners.comment: A fairly encouraging Listed fifth last time but others have more substance to their claims

runners.name: Shayem
runners.spotlight: 2yo Listed winner at Pontefract (1m, soft) last October and he appeared suited by the drop back to 1m when runner-up in the German 2,000 Guineas (1m, good) in May, behind Title Role who followed up in a US Grade 1 last Saturday; entitled to respect.
runners.comment: Runner-up in German 2,000 Guineas and form has been franked; entitled to respect

runners.name: Spanish Voice
runners.spotlight: Won on the Rowley Mile here (1m, good to firm) in May and bounced back from a lesser run at Newbury to win over this C&D (good) three weeks ago; it was a blanket finish last time but he's just 2lb higher today and the fourth has won since; this progressive 4yo is now 4-8 and is high on the list.
runners.comment: Won over C&D three weeks ago and this progressive 4yo is high on the list

runners.name: Shafdar
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won at Epsom (8.5f, good) in April on his third handicap start; he hasn't kicked on since and, while he became unbalanced and may be capable of better than he showed at Sandown last time (1m, good; sixth), others arrive with more compelling claims.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who won at Epsom in April but hasn't kicked on since

runners.name: Lion Of Alba
runners.spotlight: Easily won Chester novice (7.5f, good to firm) last August on third and final 2yo start and reappeared with midfield finish in the Italian 2,000 Guineas, before 2l fourth of 30 on handicap debut in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm); firmly in calculations now against older horses.
runners.comment: 4th of 30 in the Britannia at Royal Ascot; firmly in calculations now against older horses

runners.name: Shipbourne
runners.spotlight: Won on 2yo debut at Newbury (6.5f, soft) last October and similar form when third at Kempton (7f, AW) next time; reappeared with a last-gasp novice win at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) and this Frankel colt, who is out of 1,000 Guineas winner Special Duty, is open to further improvement tackling 1m on his handicap debut; could play a leading role.
runners.comment: 2-3 and this Frankel colt is open to further improvement; could play a leading role

runners.name: Asmen Warrior
runners.spotlight: Below par in first-time blinkers at Epsom last month but the good to soft ground may not have suited and he's back in a visor today, in which he went close at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May; has an each-way shout.
runners.comment: Below par in blinkers in Epsom but he's back in a visor, in which he went close at Windsor

runners.name: Longlai
runners.spotlight: 8yo whose form was patchy in the second half of last year and he was beaten just over 6l when fourth of nine on his reappearance here (7f, good) three weeks ago; however, he could improve for that run and the return to 1m, and he's 9lb lower than when a good third over C&D last June; not written off.
runners.comment: 8yo whose form has taken a downturn but he could improve for last month's reappearance run

runners.name: Final Night
runners.spotlight: Four wins at Kempton between last October and this March and placed twice in a row on the other Newmarket course in May (1m, good to firm/good) before solid sixth of 18 at Epsom (8.5f, good to soft) last month; his yard is in excellent form and he's an each-way contender.
runners.comment: Running consistently well and his yard is in excellent form; each-way contender

runners.name: Priapos
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May and followed up in reapplied cheekpieces (retained) in the Carlisle Bell (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago to make it four wins from his last seven starts; climbing the weights but this thriving 4yo could give another good account.
runners.comment: He's won at Carlisle last two starts and this thriving 4yo could give another good account

runners.name: Parole d'Oro
runners.spotlight: He's 0-7 in handicaps but runner-up in three, including when short-headed in this race last year (good to firm) and when returning to form at Ripon (1m2f, good) last time; could be bang there once more.
runners.comment: Short-headed in this race last year and runner-up at Ripon last time; could be bang there

runners.name: The Joker
runners.spotlight: 3yo who was placed in the spring in his first three handicaps (1m2f/1m, good) before beating his four rivals to win at Sandown (1m1f, good) last month; this is a tougher assignment but he travelled well last time and could have more to offer; possible contender.
runners.comment: Sandown win came in small field but this 3yo could have more to offer; possible contender

runners.name: Hickory
runners.spotlight: In top form at the end of last season but this 8yo hasn't performed at the same level on his three outings this year and needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: In top form at end of last season but not at the same level on his three outings this year

runners.name: Tawajjah
runners.spotlight: Well-bred 5yo by Frankel; won a novice for Roger Varian at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in November 2024 and absent since (gelded in interim); changed hands for 40,000gns in February and has joined an up-and-coming stable, but he may need this comeback outing.
runners.comment: Ex-Shadwell; has joined an up-and-coming stable but he may need this comeback outing

runners.name: Ancient Rome
runners.spotlight: He's fully 7lb lower than when a close third at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) last July but was soundly beaten on his final three outings last season and it's been the same story on his two starts this term.
runners.comment: Well treated on form as recent as last July but soundly beaten on all five starts since

runners.name: Sterling Knight
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at Epsom on Oaks day and he still had work to do when his path was blocked late on over this C&D three weeks ago; however, before those he won in good style on the other Newmarket course (1m, good) and he won this race in 2024 (good to soft); capable of having a say.
runners.comment: Things haven't gone to plan since May win but the 2024 winner is capable of having a say

runners.name: Daysofourlives
runners.spotlight: Won off this mark for Marco Botti at Doncaster (1m2f, good) in September 2024; however, absent since that November and it remains to be seen how much ability he retains; stable debut (remains in same ownership).
runners.comment: Won off this mark in September 2024 but absent since that November; stable debut

races.race_name: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Amir Lehbab
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling and a No Nay Never brother to two winners; up with the pace throughout and hung around for a close third over slightly shorter at Newbury (good to soft; 11-1); that was a likeable start.
runners.comment: Up with the pace throughout and hung around for a close third at Newbury

runners.name: Bulletsnap
runners.spotlight: 85,000euros foal; 17-2 at Goodwood (6f, soft) where he was strongest at the finish to be close up in third; raised in trip on drier ground, he's open to significant improvement.
runners.comment: 17-2 at Goodwood (6f, soft) where he strongest at the finish to be close up in third

runners.name: Ottoman Chief
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt who cost 2,200,000gns at last year's Tattersalls October Book 1 sale; half-brother to winners Ottoman Fleet (8.5f-1m2f; Grade 2; RPR 121), Inverlochy (1m/8.6f; 86) and Ottoman Empress (1m 2yo; 83); dam French 1m1f/9.7f winner; runs here in preference to a strong Newmarket maiden on Saturday; hood fitted.
runners.comment: Cost 2,200,000gns at last year's Tattersalls October Book 1 sale; hood fitted

runners.name: Quest For Stars
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars colt who cost 700,000euros as a yearling; first foal out of a French 1m 2yo Listed winner (RPR 100); he does look the stable second string on jockey bookings.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars colt who cost 700,000euros as a yearling; yard 2nd string on jockeys

runners.name: Night Star
runners.spotlight: At 6-1 he was a shorter price than Amir Lehbab when they clashed at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) and this £60,000 yearling wasn't beaten far into fifth after a troubled run; improvement would appear a formality.
runners.comment: Behind Amir Lehbab at Newbury but this colt was eyecatching from off the pace

runners.name: Arctic Force
runners.spotlight: 550,000gns yearling and brother to 1m3f/1m4f winner Thunder Kiss (Group 3; RPR 113); dam Listed-placed 1m4f-2m AW winner (100); holds a Group 1 entry in Ireland and has to be of strong interest.
runners.comment: 550,000gns yearling; holds a Group 1 entry in Ireland and has to be of strong interest

runners.name: Gerry's Darling
runners.spotlight: Never got involved when eighth of 13 over C&D last month (good to firm) and this is probably a stronger race.
runners.comment: Never got involved when eighth of 13 over C&D last month; this looks stronger

races.race_name: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)

runners.name: According To Mark
runners.spotlight: Beaten in small fields this season, latterly at odds-on behind a well-bred filly who has since finished third off a BHA mark of 82; he'll need more to win this but he's seemingly held in some regard and has been gelded.
runners.comment: Needs more but he's seemingly held in some regard and has been gelded

runners.name: Hatteen
runners.spotlight: No wins in four but he's useful and beat all bar subsequent Queen's Vase fourth Point Of Law over 1m2f at Newbury in mid-May; led that day and should put up another bold show.
runners.comment: Beat all bar subsequent Queen's Vase fourth Point Of Law over 1m2f at Newbury in mid-May

runners.name: Brave Hunter
runners.spotlight: Given every chance when going down narrowly in a 1m4f Newmarket handicap 20 days ago; that form entitles him to a second look here (in new cheekpieces) but he is 0-6 and others should have greater potential.
runners.comment: Career-best last time but now 0-6 and others should have greater potential

runners.name: Poker
runners.spotlight: By Wootton Bassett and out of a sister to Oaks winner Was, he fetched 4,300,000gns in 2024; he can be forgiven his no-show in last month's soft-ground Derby and his previous second at Haydock (first-time cheekpieces retained since) was behind a stablemate who went on to finish close up in the Queen's Vase; respected.
runners.comment: Not living up to his pedigree but still useful and Derby no-show is readily forgiven

runners.name: Sea And Sun
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in both his races and beaten only a neck in the latest (1m4f, good), but appears to have the weakest form claims of those with experience.
runners.comment: Appears to have the weakest form claims of those with experience

runners.name: Count Bezukhov
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; made a promising debut over this trip at Leopardstown and then won at the Curragh (first-time tongue-tie) when perhaps inconvenienced by the drop back to 1m2f; can pick holes in that form but he's a promising colt who looks a stayer in the making.
runners.comment: 1m2f maiden winner at the Curragh; promising colt who looks a stayer in the making

runners.name: Saifo
runners.spotlight: 52,000gns yearling by Wootton Bassett; first foal out of a 1m-1m4f maiden (RPR 73), sister to 1m Listed winner Sir John Lavery; stable's newcomers are usually best watched.
runners.comment: 52,000gns yearling by Wootton Bassett; first foal out of a 1m-1m4f maiden (RPR 73)

runners.name: Shoof Baeed
runners.spotlight: Had the run of things up front when flooring an ex-Irish 1-3 chance at Redcar (1m2f, good) but he posted a useful RPR for a newcomer; hard to dismiss.
runners.comment: Had the run of things up front when flooring a 1-3 chance at Redcar; posted useful RPR

races.race_name: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap

runners.name: Tazaman
runners.spotlight: A dual winner (1m4f/2m1f, good to firm) in 2025; perhaps better again in his recent seconds, the latest from off the pace at Redcar (1m6f); can race prominently, which might be a wise idea in this small field.
runners.comment: Won twice last year and recent seconds represents form of the same level, at least

runners.name: Nanny Park
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in 2024 and hasn't been at her best in four races for current yard; she was never that threatening when third of six last time (1m4f); steps up in trip.
runners.comment: Sole win was in 2024 and hasn't been at her best in four races for current yard

runners.name: Lordsbridge Grey
runners.spotlight: Seven defeats include four handicaps, the best of which was a close third on good to soft at Yarmouth last September (1m); didn't convince stamina-wise over 1m2f last time and now has a good deal further to travel.
runners.comment: Didn't convince stamina-wise over 1m2f last time and now goes even further

runners.name: Twilight Safari
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden and latest close third at Catterick (2m, good to firm) came in a field of four, so that form looks a tad dubious.
runners.comment: Still a maiden and latest close third at Catterick (2m, good/firm) came in a field of four

runners.name: Golden Flame
runners.spotlight: Exposed 8yo but he was returning from 264 days off when winning by 3.5l at Ffos Las nine days ago (2m, good), despite pulling hard; Zoe Lewis rides again with a 4lb penalty; if as good again he'll be tough to beat.
runners.comment: Back from a long break to win at Ffos Las despite pulling hard; carries 4lb penalty

runners.name: Room Fourteen
runners.spotlight: Consistent since raised to this sort of trip in handicaps and was nicely on top late on at Redcar (good) the last time; still looks well handicapped off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Nicely on top last time at Redcar and still looks well handicapped off 4lb higher

runners.name: Suddenly I See
runners.spotlight: Successful handicap debut at Musselburgh in April when making all off 4lb lower; below that level since, including when able to lead at Lingfield last time (1m1f, good to firm) on the back of a gelding operation.
runners.comment: Made all in April but below that level since, latterly after a gelding operation

runners.name: Intrusively
runners.spotlight: Good and bad in five runs for this yard, but wasn't beaten far the last time at Newcastle (1m) and on the evidence of that run this far is worth exploring.
runners.comment: Inconsistent but a fair run last time and this far is worth exploring

runners.name: Obito
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year on good ground, latterly over 1m2f; close to best form when second at Hamilton in June but has disappointed either side of that.
runners.comment: Close to best form when second at Hamilton in June but disappointed either side of that

runners.name: Domination
runners.spotlight: 0-4 for Clive Cox but 2-3 for this yard after narrow wins at Ripon (1m, good to soft) and over C&D (good to firm); came from off the pace a month ago to collect by a half-length off 5lb lower; well bred, he might well have more to offer.
runners.comment: 0-4 for Clive Cox but 2-3 for this yard; well bred, he might well have more to offer

runners.name: Island Bear
runners.spotlight: Initially promising but hasn't kicked on in handicaps (0-3; 7f-1m) and blinkers are removed after last time; bit to prove, though getting back on fast ground is a likely plus.
runners.comment: Initially promising but hasn't kicked on in handicaps (0-3; 7f-1m); bit to prove now

runners.name: Brighton View
runners.spotlight: First time over this far and his first handicap when winning by a neck at Newbury (1m2f, good; 2lb lower); finished last at Sandown where he hung left-handed throughout; better expected returned to a left-handed track.
runners.comment: Newbury winner who hung left-handed throughout when finishing last at Sandown

runners.name: Big Eagle
runners.spotlight: His standout run is the middle one when beaten a neck at Kempton (1m AW); possibilities on handicap debut if tapping into that promise on the back of wind surgery; market informative.
runners.comment: Useful middle run; had a wind operation ahead of this handicap debut

runners.name: Princess Niyla
runners.spotlight: Having her 39th race and still seeking first win away from Beverley; has run some fair races this season but not last time and others appeal more.
runners.comment: Has run some fair races this season but not last time and others appeal more

runners.name: Myrrh
runners.spotlight: Did well last season at about 1m but yet to get overly competitive in four handicaps, from 1m2f to 1m4f; perhaps this drop in trip can halt the slide.
runners.comment: Struggled in handicaps from 1m2f to 1m4f; could halt the slide back at 1m

runners.name: Norcross Brow
runners.spotlight: First run for this yard when third in a Class 5 at Newmarket (1m) and then comfortably justified odds of 8-11 in a Class 6 at Brighton (7f, good to firm); 5lb higher here even with a 6lb penalty and probably the one to beat.
runners.comment: Positive start for this yard and easily won a Class 6 at Brighton; 5lb higher here

runners.name: The Anthony Gover
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and beaten in the region of 3l in his two handicaps, over 7f on the AW and good ground; down 4lb for those and best RPR came over 8.6f on debut; can run well.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and beaten in the region of 3l in his two handicaps; dropped 4lb

runners.name: Celtic Chariot
runners.spotlight: Did a bit of hanging but was only 2.5l away on handicap debut at Wetherby (1m, good to firm); might be learning on the job and progress further.
runners.comment: Did a bit of hanging but was only 2.5l away on handicap debut at Wetherby (1m)

runners.name: Okiru
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but was in first-time blinkers when second at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) and he might well have won had he not blown the start; considered.
runners.comment: Might well have won in the new blinkers at Chepstow had he not blown the start

runners.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners.spotlight: Second at Thirsk before nosing home at Redcar (1m, good; 3lb lower) and not the first time she's been below par at Ripon a month ago; could easily bounce back from that.
runners.comment: In good form until last time and that's not the first time she's been below par at Ripon

runners.name: Wrydcroft
runners.spotlight: Only contested seven handicaps and won four; would have gone close in Alpha Capture's race here last time had he broken on terms; chance.
runners.comment: 4-7 in handicaps; would have gone closer in the latest had he broke on terms
runners.owner: G Libson And Mrs P Sly

runners.name: Return Of The Gods
runners.spotlight: 6f maiden winner on the AW; wore a tongue-tie on handicap debut but that was soon discarded and he ran well behind one completing a hat-trick at Nottingham; tries 7f for the first time and that could trigger something.
runners.comment: Lightly raced winner; tries 7f for the first time and that could trigger something

runners.name: Lope El Fuego
runners.spotlight: Newbury novice winner over 6f and ran in a Listed race on final run last season; a disappointing return on handicap debut leaves her with questions to answer; unraced beyond 6f.
runners.comment: A disappointing return on handicap debut leaves her with questions to answer

runners.name: Lord Capulet
runners.spotlight: Had a good season already and Toby Moore's claim is welcomed when he might be a shade high in the weights now; beaten 2l at Chester last time, just behind King's School whom he beat the time before.
runners.comment: Toby Moore's claim is welcomed when he might be a shade high in the weights

runners.name: Highland Shah
runners.spotlight: Keen-goer who has been hooded for his last two races; up with the pace and ridden out to win on handicap debut at Musselburgh (7f, good); just 3lb higher and by no means exposed.
runners.comment: Musselburgh winner a month ago; just 3lb higher and by no means exposed

runners.name: Stanage
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in March of 2025 off 11lb higher; 0-12 in the meantime and quiet so far this term.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in March 2025 off 11lb higher; 0-12 in meantime and quiet so far this term

runners.name: Monsieur Bondy
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f novices last year; no better than seventh in three handicaps and needs to step up.
runners.comment: Won two 7f novices last year; no better than seventh in three handicaps

runners.name: King's School
runners.spotlight: All four wins at Newcastle but nothing wrong with latest second at Chester, especially as he missed the break; good chance off 1lb higher.
runners.comment: All four wins at Newcastle but nothing wrong with latest second at Chester

runners.name: Alpha Capture
runners.spotlight: Formerly with William Haggas and Willie Mullins; consistent for this yard and deserved his battling win over C&D latest; can run well again off just 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Consistent for this yard and deserved his battling win over C&D latest

runners.name: Bella Bisbee
runners.spotlight: Second course win when beating 11 rivals here last month, but only fifth on her return visit; back down 1lb.
runners.comment: Second course win when beating 11 rivals here last month, but only fifth on return visit

races.race_name: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Powernap
runners.spotlight: Lost her first ten races but the win had been coming and she stormed clear at Catterick (5f, good to soft; fine on faster); now in a higher grade on the back of a 9lb rise but something appears to have clicked.
runners.comment: Now in a higher grade on the back of a 9lb rise but something appears to have clicked

runners.name: Koffee And Kale
runners.spotlight: Sole win in ten races came on final run of last season in a 5f novice; beaten four times since a gelding operation, no closer than about 4l; cheekpieces replace the visor tried last time.
runners.comment: Beaten four times since a gelding operation, no closer than about 4l

runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.spotlight: All four wins were over 6f for two Newmarket yards; 0-11 for current one and others are in better form.
runners.comment: All four wins were over 6f for two Newmarket yards; 0-11 for current one
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Donald
runners.spotlight: Best run was his second in a novice last season but only three ran; opposable on his handicap form and blinkers did nothing last time.
runners.comment: Opposable on his handicap debut and blinkers did nothing last time

runners.name: Bayraat
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has returned from a break in fine form and won by a length over this far at Wetherby (good to firm); back up 4lb but had dropped to a good mark.
runners.comment: Won by a length over this far at Wetherby; up 4lb but had dropped to a good mark

runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins for Scott Dixon this winter and he is just 1lb higher than for March's 5f success; finished last at Lingfield in April but that was a stiffer task than this.
runners.comment: Finished last at Lingfield in April but that was a stiffer task than this

runners.name: Spirit Of Applause
runners.spotlight: Having his 50th career start and reliable in the main; close up last week at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) after racing up with the pace; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Having his 50th career start and reliable in the main; close up last week at Nottingham

runners.name: Dicko The Legend
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins have been over 6f at York, the latest last summer off 1lb lower; found some trouble in running when third at Pontefract last time and has another big effort in him.
runners.comment: On a good mark and found some trouble in running when third at Pontefract last time
runners.owner: Mrs S Hibbert, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Lieutenant Sir
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who looks better for being gelded, last time gaining a hard-fought one-length win at Ffos Las (6f, good); penalised accordingly but Brodie Hampson is a big asset in these races.
runners.comment: Penalised for recent Ffos Las win; Brodie Hampson is a big asset in these races

runners.name: Hurt You Never
runners.spotlight: Only fifth in a field of six last week at Nottingham, but was close up behind Spirit Of Applause and that represented some return to form.
runners.comment: Only fifth in a field of six last week at Nottingham but that was some return to form

runners.name: Wid
runners.spotlight: Daughter of Wootton Bassett who built on debut promise with a running-on second of nine in 7.5f maiden at Ffos Las on her return 16 days ago; capable of better still and a big player here for yard well among the winners.
runners.comment: Shaped well when second at Ffos Las latest; more to offer so a big player for in-form yard

runners.name: Star Of The Desert
runners.spotlight: Sent off 50-1 but made a promising start with second of 13 in 1m novice at Southwell three weeks ago; this son of Knicks Go should build on it here.
runners.comment: Promising start with second at Southwell; this son of Knicks Go should build on it here

runners.name: Bella Angelina
runners.spotlight: Underwent wind surgery before shaping well when a debut third of 12 in novice at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 25 days ago; the hood is left off today; this daughter of Kingman seems sure to do better.
runners.comment: Had wind op before debut Doncaster third; the hood is left off; seems sure to do better

runners.name: Leopards Rock
runners.spotlight: Territories gelding who has shown fair form when placed in novices at Wolverhampton (8.5f) and Newcastle (7f) this summer; may do better still so must enter calculations on his turf debut.
runners.comment: Placed in novices at Wolverhampton and Newcastle; must enter calculations on turf debut

runners.name: Rake Lane
runners.spotlight: 50-1, debut seventh of 11 in 7f novice at Newcastle 13 days ago; lots more is required from this Bated Breath colt.
runners.comment: Debut seventh at Newcastle 13 days ago; lots more is required from this Bated Breath colt

runners.name: Blairtum Night
runners.spotlight: 80-1, eighth of ten in 7f novice at Newcastle on his debut in November; this son of Night Of Thunder needs to take a major step forward.
runners.comment: Eighth in novice at Newcastle on his debut in November; needs to take a major step forward

races.race_name: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Celestia
runners.spotlight: 12-1, shaped well when a debut third of nine in novice at Newmarket (7f, good) 20 days ago; this Sea The Stars filly seems sure to build on it.
runners.comment: Shaped well for debut third at Newmarket; seems sure to build on it

runners.name: Pequenita
runners.spotlight: 11-4, made a promising debut when fourth of nine in 7f novice at Kempton last month; that form has been franked so this Dubawi filly merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: Promising debut Kempton fourth (form franked); Dubawi filly merits serious consideration

runners.name: Mohaymenah
runners.spotlight: Minzaal filly who took a big step forward from her debut fourth when a clear second of six in 7f Wolverhampton novice in May; capable of better still.
runners.comment: Clear second of six in 7f Wolverhampton novice in May; capable of better still

runners.name: Rogue Passion
runners.spotlight: 15-2, encouraging fourth of five in maiden at Catterick (7f, good) on her debut four weeks ago, keeping on late; this Sioux Nation filly can take a step forward here.
runners.comment: Encouraging debut fourth at Catterick; this Sioux Nation filly can take a step forward

runners.name: Harlequin Gift
runners.spotlight: 14-1 and green when a never-dangerous seventh of nine in maiden at Haydock (6f, good) on her debut in May; this daughter of Advertise can improve a fair bit for the experience.
runners.comment: Green when seventh at Haydock on her debut; can improve a fair bit for the experience

runners.name: Ottoman
runners.spotlight: Gained sole victory at Leicester (1m2f) last June and back in good form of late, beaten a neck when runner-up in 1m4f Leicester handicap two weeks ago; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb in a headgear change.
runners.comment: In good form, runner-up at Leicester two weeks ago; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb

runners.name: Fleur De Mer
runners.spotlight: In good form until a below-par sixth of eight in 1m7f handicap at Ayr 20 days ago; the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: In good form until a below-par sixth at Ayr latest; the sort to bounce back
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Wolf Of Badenoch
runners.spotlight: Winless since his debut in 2024 and he arrives below par, only sixth in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap last time; also has his stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Winless since his debut in 2024 and he arrives below par; also has his stamina to prove

runners.name: Hijo De La Luna
runners.spotlight: Finally gained a first win in 9.5f classified event at Wolverhampton in February; not proved easy to catch right since and beat one in 1m6f Redcar handicap last time; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Not proving easy to catch right and beat one at Redcar last time; others are preferred

runners.name: Due To Shine
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has failed to beat a rival in handicaps at Newcastle (1m2f) and Thirsk (1m4f) this season; easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in handicaps at Newcastle and Thirsk this season

runners.name: Is She Now
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who was quick to make her mark for Daragh Bourke, landing 1m5f classified event at Ayr before following up in 1m4f Musselburgh handicap later in June; posted another good effort under a penalty with fourth at Ayr (1m5f) last time; major player.
runners.comment: Scored at Ayr and Musselburgh before good fourth at Ayr (1m5f) last time; major player

runners.name: Broadstone
runners.spotlight: He's 0-17 and came in last of 13 in 1m2f classified event at Newcastle last time; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: He's 0-17 and came in last of 13 in 1m2f classified event at Newcastle last time

runners.name: Instant Bond
runners.spotlight: It took him a long time to get off the mark but he has won three of his last six starts and two of his last three; form of latest Pontefract (6f, good) success couldn't be working out much better (second, third and fourth all won next time) and a 3lb rise is no issue; obvious chance.
runners.comment: Won three of his last six and latest win working out extremely well; obvious claims
runners.owner: David Tate, Danny Lawson & Kevin Broadley

runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: He hasn't run badly in Class 6 handicaps on his last two starts but is still operating below his best; likely to run well all the same.
runners.comment: Not beaten far in Class 6 events on last two starts and he's a contender in this field.

runners.name: Miss Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Game effort to win a 5f handicap at Thirsk (good ground) last month; dropped away having made the running at Newcastle 13 days ago; has run well at Carlisle before but over 5f and this test might be stiffer than ideal.
runners.comment: 5f turf win last month but she failed to back it up on AW latest; easier 6f preferable

runners.name: Henriette Ronner
runners.spotlight: 6f AW win for William Haggas in January (blinkered first time); struggled in three runs for Martin Dunne in the spring and she has finished out the back in two runs for new connections; new headgear tried but risky.
runners.comment: On a winning mark but she needs the change of headgear to spark an upturn in her fortunes

runners.name: Soda
runners.spotlight: Whiff of promise in three novice/maiden runs but she was well beaten on her handicap debut at Redcar (1m, good) 19 days ago; drops in trip with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a 1m handicap 19 days ago; drops in trip and still has low mileage

runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: Three 6f AW wins for Iain Jardine in the spring; also ran well on turf at Hamilton in May but his form has dipped since; not on a bad mark and his stable is going well but he does need to raise his game again.
runners.comment: Three 6f AW wins this spring; form has cooled more recently; others preferred

runners.name: Orbital Chime
runners.spotlight: Ended his time with James Owen with a couple of lesser efforts and he could only manage a midfield finish here (7f, soft) on last month's stable debut; dropping down the weights but others are stronger.
runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but after some lesser recent efforts

runners.name: Great
runners.spotlight: Had some fair form for Richard Hannon last season; running creditably for current stable without really threatening; now drops into a Class 6 and he is one to note for market confidence.
runners.comment: Not matched his 2025 form for new stable but he now drops into a Class 6; check betting

runners.name: Kyber Crystal
runners.spotlight: Ran okay on her seasonal return in April but she hasn't built on it in four runs since; had 17 runs at 6f+ and she has been unplaced in all of them.
runners.comment: Not built on encouraging return; unplaced all 17 runs at 6f+

runners.name: Catalyse
runners.spotlight: Still to add to his debut win in 14 subsequent outings and it has been tough going so far for this stable; now drops into a Class 6 and a revival wouldn't be out of the question.
runners.comment: Yet to shine for Jim Goldie but he's dropping into a Class 6 & a revival could be imminent

runners.name: Bay Breeze
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner, the latest over C&D (good to soft) 14 months ago off a 5lb higher mark; capable at this level but slower ground would have been preferable.
runners.comment: C&D win last May came off 5lb higher; slower ground would have been preferable

runners.name: Creative Queen
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt (blinkered first time) when making all in a 6f fillies' novice at Yarmouth (soft) in May; only midfield on her handicap debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago and she needs to leave that behind; well bred and in excellent hands so that's not out of the question.
runners.comment: Disappointing on handicap debut but drops back in trip and she's bred to do better yet

runners.name: Cotai Belle
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo and she has run well for second in a couple of stronger fillies' handicaps (6f, good) on her last two starts; Ethan Tindall's claim helps matters and she is high on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Runner-up in stronger races on last two starts; good apprentice booked; major player

runners.name: Rogue Attraction
runners.spotlight: Highly tried after her wide-margin maiden win last summer and she has come up short; perhaps stretched by 7f here (good to firm; cheekpieces first time) on her seasonal/handicap debut two weeks ago; dropped 3lb and still has time to dip back into her early promise.
runners.comment: Drop back to 6f can help and she still has time to dip back into her early promise

runners.name: Bleep Test
runners.spotlight: Of interest on her 2yo best but neither handicap run has been convincing; she should be sharper with her recent reappearance behind her but not the most solid of options.
runners.comment: Promise last summer but neither handicap run has been convincing

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: On a competitive mark and ran well for fourth in a good handicap at Ayr (6f, good) on Monday; one to take seriously back against her own sex.
runners.comment: On handy mark and she ran well for 4th in a well-contested Ayr handicap on Monday; chance

runners.name: D Flawless
runners.spotlight: A hood has helped in recent starts, winning at Newcastle (6f) in March and running creditably in turf handicaps (6f/5f, both good ground) twice last month; needs more to come out on top here.
runners.comment: Has done well since a hood was fitted but she needs to raise her game to beat the 3yos

runners.name: Mae Amor
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 66-1 shock on her seasonal return at Hamilton (6f, good) in May; two heavy defeats have followed and others are safer.
runners.comment: Two heavy defeats following her shock reappearance win in May; others are safer

runners.name: Ormolulu
runners.spotlight: Hold-up mare who hasn't found her best form yet this season; slipping down the weights and she's likely to come good again soon, albeit her record suggests that might be on AW.
runners.comment: Yet to shine this year but becoming well treated; type to come good again soon

races.race_name: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)

runners.name: Supreme Clarets
runners.spotlight: Back to his best when finishing second of nine in a 7f handicap at Musselburgh 17 days ago; runs off the same mark today and another big run should be forthcoming.
runners.comment: 0-10 but he went close at Musselburgh last month; another big run on the cards

runners.name: Albeseeingyer
runners.spotlight: Two of her six wins have come over C&D; in and out this year but her second at Leicester in April and her C&D third last month both bring her right into the reckoning; one to take seriously.
runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner; good third here last month; high on the list

runners.name: Record Day
runners.spotlight: His first four starts came over 7f but he showed improvement dropped to 6f when a close third at Thirsk last month; a slow start did him no favours dropped to 5f at Newcastle a fortnight ago; now returns to 7f with cheekpieces fitted; stable also runs Homestrait.
runners.comment: Ran well over 6f on penultimate run; slow start costly over 5f latest; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Dakota Breeze
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in three starts on the AW during the winter but he was a well-beaten 66-1 shot on his handicap debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago; this is weaker but he still has a point to prove.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 66-1 shot on last month's handicap debut at Newbury; this is easier at least

runners.name: Homestrait
runners.spotlight: Solid in-frame efforts on her last four starts; a stiff 7f should be fine for her now but drying ground perhaps not ideal.
runners.comment: Running well in defeat this year; sound form claims but drying ground perhaps not ideal

runners.name: Ecclefechan
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; last of eight at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago when cheekpieces (now absent) were tried; others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Inconsistent 12-race maiden; headgear experiment quickly aborted; others more persuasive

runners.name: Yaaser
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on his 2025 form; yet to get going this time around, typically blowing the start, but it wouldn't be a bolt from the blue were he to bounce back in this company.
runners.comment: Thrown in on 2025 form; yet to sparkle this year but better expected today

runners.name: Black Storm
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk maiden on his second start but beaten 14 times since; went close at Musselburgh (7f, good) last month though and a subsequent lesser effort can be partially excused by him getting upset in the stalls.
runners.comment: On a losing run of 14 but he had a near miss at Musselburgh last month; chance

runners.name: Top Lad
runners.spotlight: Some promise in novice/maiden events as a 2yo; low-key seasonal/handicap debut at Beverley (7.4f, good to soft) in April; enough to prove for now.
runners.comment: Well beaten on seasonal/handicap debut in April; enough to prove

runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over 6f on AW; two good runs at Carlisle this summer, second in May and third on Saturday, but they were over 6f and his stamina for this trip is the obvious concern.
runners.comment: Two wins on AW; runs this track well too but his stamina for 7f is a concern
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr

runners.name: Sailor's Return
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; sixth in two 7f fillies' handicaps for new yard, the latest at Doncaster last week; improvement required to defy this mark.
runners.comment: Only sixth in two runs for her new stable this summer; needs more to take this

runners.name: Judicature
runners.spotlight: 6f AW win last summer; began this campaign with good handicap runs at Haydock (6f, good to firm) and over C&D (soft); two lesser efforts have followed but he will be dangerous if back to the C&D form.
runners.comment: Started the year with two good runs, including C&D; below that level twice since though

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Margot Mae
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly, 115,000gns yearling; raced keenly and betrayed inexperience on Navan debut in late April; now looks the part on the strength of C&D third at the beginning of last month; form has been franked by the Aidan O'Brien-trained runner-up Alpha in winning easily at the Curragh
runners.comment: Looks the part on the strength of C&D third, form has been franked by runner-up Alpha

runners.name: Carafinn
runners.spotlight: E120,000 yearling; finished fourth in a 6f Naas barrier trial; can improve from a satisfactory fourth on her official debut at Cork,  form advertised by a Group 3 success for the winner Ballinea Star.
runners.comment: Showed promise first time out at Cork, form advertised by a Group 3 success for the winner

runners.name: Nevermindtherain
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never half-sister to Group 1 juvenile winner Puerto Rico; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (102), sister to Group 1 winners Misty For Me and Ballydoyle; weak second favourite, looked raw on Cork debut in April (5f, soft); failed to show the progress that might have been expected at Navan (5f, yielding); up in trip now, premature to write off.
runners.comment: Has failed to run to expectations on her first two starts, premature to write off
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Bellesque
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-sister to eight winners, including Australian Group winner Adjusted, Old Glory (Group-placed as a juvenile) and Giuseppe Piazzi (Scandinavian Group 3s; 98); dam French 1m1f winner; merits respect.
runners.comment: Half-sister to eight winners including Australian Group 2 scorer Adjusted, merits respect
runners.owner: Mrs E Irwin & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Shenata
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Sheyya and Shelbiana; dam 7f winner, half-sister to smart 7f/1m winner Shelir; stable in form, same colours as Katiriya.
runners.comment: Third foal; half-sister to winners Sheyya and Shelbiana, dam 7f winner, stable in form
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: A Girl Named Sioux
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister by Sioux Nation to three winners, best of them Keeper Of Time, a Group 3 C&D scorer; dam Italian Listed-placed winner; in good hands.
runners.comment: Half-sister to winners, best of them C&D Group 3 scorer Keeper Of Time, in good hands

runners.name: Arizonaneargalway
runners.spotlight: Arizona filly; E5,000 yearling; half-sister to five winners; dam 7f AW winner; yard not known for juvenile maiden winners; 7lb claimer aboard.
runners.comment: Cheap yearling, half-sister to five winners, yard not known for 2yo maiden winners

runners.name: Katiraya
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner, Oasis Dream half-sister to two winners, out of 1m4f winning half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Katiyra and 1m4f Group 3 winner Kataniya; good pedigree, sire may supply pace, stamina on dam's side.
runners.comment: First foal; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner, sire may supply pace, stamina on dam's side
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Maire Rua
runners.spotlight: Third foal; sister to the trainer's Group 3-winning filly Red Letter (Group 1-placed in the Pretty Polly recently) and yard's maiden winner Res Ipsa; dam Listed-placed 6f AW 2yo winner; capable of making her presence felt first time out.
runners.comment: Of definite interest as a half-sister to the stable's Group 3-winning filly Red Letter

runners.name: Stormy Dawn
runners.spotlight: Not from a usual source of juvenile winners; Soldier's Call filly is the second foal out of a winning daughter of Dandy Man.
runners.comment: Not from a usual source of juvenile winners, second foal out of a winning dam

runners.name: Voice Of You
runners.spotlight: Third foal; by Dark Angel, dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Tarana (Listed and dam of 1m2f/1m4f Group 1 winner Tarnawa), Tarankali, and Tasalk; out of a 1m4f Listed winner; best watched.
runners.comment: Third foal; dam unraced half-sister to several useful winners, best watched

runners.name: Honey Deuce
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly; substantial improvement needed from her C&D debut five weeks ago, when slowly away and unable to land a blow; unlikely to reverse form with Margot Mae.
runners.comment: Substantial improvement is needed from her C&D debut five weeks ago, held by Margot Mae

runners.name: Fine Line
runners.spotlight: Towards the rear on debut at Cork; well held by fourth-placed Carafinn.
runners.comment: Towards the rear on debut at Cork, well held by fourth-placed Carafinn

runners.name: Zenford
runners.spotlight: Rewarded for a string of consistent efforts with a win at Limerick on latest (7f, soft) off 5lb lower; closely matched with Invincible Will on Curragh running in May; looks progressive and should go well again but majority of form on easier ground than this.
runners.comment: Up 5lb for Limerick win on latest, should go well again but might prefer easier ground

runners.name: Venetian Star
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden was denied by 0.5l by Zenford at Limerick last time out (7f, soft) and just 2lb higher now; went close on good ground at Fairyhouse in May; in the mix again but needs to find a bit more to get his head in front.
runners.comment: Maiden went close behind Zenford latest, up 2lb, in the mix but more needed to win

runners.name: Dark Leader
runners.spotlight: Promise in all three maidens earlier this season at 7f-1m on good and yielding ground; had Zenford 0.75l behind when runner up at Limerick (7f, yielding) in April off level weights and 7lb better off here; opening mark may be lenient and could go well in first handicap.
runners.comment: Handicap debutant, weighted to uphold maiden form with Zenford, could go well

runners.name: Chapel Lane
runners.spotlight: Placed in a couple of maidens last season at 6f-1m on good ground; soundly beaten on seasonal return/handicap debut at Down Royal in May (10.5f, good) but improved effort dropped back to 1m at the Curragh last time; eased 1lb for that 4l defeat and this shorter trip should be fine; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Step forward over 1m at the Curragh on latest, drop to 7f should be fine, not dismissed

runners.name: Watch Tower
runners.spotlight: Best two efforts in four maiden runs came over 7f at Dundalk last winter; not a bad run on handicap bow and seasonal return at Limerick (7f, soft) behind Zenford and Venetian Star; same mark here and Keane takes over now; ran well on good ground at the Curragh last term; interesting.
runners.comment: Pleasing run on h'cap debut/seasonal return, Keane takes over now, interesting

runners.name: Mighty Danu
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f maiden (yielding) on debut at the Galway festival last season; only seen twice since, well beaten in listed race over this C&D (gd-yld) in September and again in fillies' race at Killarney on latest; best watched on handicap bow with a return trip to Ballybrit likely on the horizon.
runners.comment: Galway maiden winner last year, makes handicap debut now, likely best watched

runners.name: Invincible Will
runners.spotlight: Gained a second career win when beating Zenford by a short head at the Curragh (7f, good) on penultimate; soundly beaten off 5lb higher mark back there on latest; may be on a tough mark for now.
runners.comment: Beat Zenford by a short head on penultimate, no impact off revised mark on latest

runners.name: Caitouna
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on second handicap start at Fairyhouse (7f, good) eight days ago under Colin Keane; raised 5lb for that and moves up in grade but relatively unexposed so could be more to come and another top rider booked; not discounted.
runners.comment: Up 5lb and in grade after Fairyhouse win latest, relatively unexposed and not discounted

runners.name: Dawn Romance
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f maiden at Naas (good) on third start last season; came up short in listed company on next two starts and disappointed on handicap debut at Naas on latest (6f, good); moves up in trip; new visor needs to revive.
runners.comment: Poor form since Naas maiden win last season, upped in trip, visor goes on now

runners.name: Time Bender
runners.spotlight: Sprang a 33-1 surprise in a C&D maiden (good) last July; last of six in Tipperary listed race the following month; weakened on soft ground upped to 1m on handicap debut here when last seen in October; gelded, 4lb lower now and worth a market check on return.
runners.comment: Surprise C&D maiden winner last season, off since October, gelded, check market

races.race_name: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Fingerpaint
runners.spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden on debut last year and was a fine third in a Tipperary Group 3 next time after a 100-day break; didn't seem to handle heavy ground on final start last year; again below her best on return at Navan; will held by Duckadilly on that running.
runners.comment: Rated 3lb superior to stablemate Bella Isabella, well held by Duckadilly on Navan run

runners.name: Duckadilly
runners.spotlight: Decent overall form since fourth in this race 12 months ago; gained first win at stakes level when taking a Listed fillies' event at Navan last month; seemed to appreciate the step up to 1m that day, but was found wanting in a deeper race at the Curragh on Irish Derby weekend.
runners.comment: Decent overall form since fourth in this race 12 months ago, Listed 1m winner this term

runners.name: Chantez
runners.spotlight: C&D Listed winner at two; third in this race 12 months ago, in front of Duckadilly who is a much better mare now; could feature if stepping up from her first run of the season at Naas in May; first time with blinkers.
runners.comment: C&D Listed winner at two, third here 12 months ago (in front of Duckadilly) could feature

runners.name: Phenomenal Filly
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on second of three starts at two; fine effort when fifth in the 30-runner Goffs Million; relatively unexposed and could be good enough to cope with her five older rivals.
runners.comment: C&D winner on second start, fifth in the Goffs Million, relatively unexposed, interesting

runners.name: Nancy J
runners.spotlight: Won a 2yo maiden on debut for Jessica Harrington; ran some good races in defeat last year; joined Johnny Murtagh this term; stable in great form, but this 83-rated filly is not well treated by the race conditions.
runners.comment: Stable in great form but this 83-rated filly is not well treated by the race conditions

runners.name: Bella Isabella
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 7f at Cork last season and took third of eight in a C&D Group 3  good) next time; C&D handicap winner five weeks ago on second outing of the campaign; currently rated 3lb inferior to stablemate Fingerpaint.
runners.comment: C&D handicap winner five weeks ago, best form last season was a C&D Group 3 third placing

runners.name: Zaraahmando
runners.spotlight: 3-17 on turf; low key start to this campaign but back on song on latest when a neck second over C&D behind Heliogabalus; hit with a 6lb rise for that fine effort and has never won off a mark this high but place claims nonetheless.
runners.comment: Raised 6lb for C&D second latest, has never won off a mark this high, place claims

runners.name: Hamiyan
runners.spotlight: 0-5; promise in maidens but hasn't made an impact in first two handicaps, here last October (1m, yld-sft) and at the Curragh when last seen in April (1m, sft); cheekpieces reached for and a bit to prove for now.
runners.comment: Promise in maidens, no impact in first two handicaps, cheekpieces reached for now
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Eddie G
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner is 0-13 on turf but has gone close in defeat; some of best efforts have come at Galway so likely to be heading to Ballybrit; however, not beaten far at Down Royal last time (7f, soft) and 1lb lower now so place shout, though could be drawn better.
runners.comment: 0-13 on turf, not beaten far latest, drawn wide here but place shout

runners.name: Dark Viper
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins last season on good and heavy ground; yet to hit top gear this term but has slipped 4lb below his last success and hinted that he might be coming back to form at Ballinrobe on latest; not discounted.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins last year, now 4lb below the latest one, hinted at return to form on latest

runners.name: Heliogabalus
runners.spotlight: Gained second win of career over C&D (good) on seasonal return last month, beating Zaraahmando by a neck; 8lb rise makes things tougher but Keane booked and he's well drawn so can't be totally discounted.
runners.comment: C&D win on seasonal return, raised 8lb but Keane booked and well drawn, can't discount

runners.name: Ocean Manifest
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner; yet to score on turf but has run well in defeat, his best effort coming in a Killarney maiden last July (1m, yld-sft); okay run at Dundalk latest but might prefer a bit of an ease on return to the grass.
runners.comment: Two-time AW winner, best effort on turf came on yld-sft, might prefer a bit of an ease
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Ballymagreehan
runners.spotlight: Won in fine style at Gowran (1m, gd-yld) in May but paid a price for that 4l success, going up 10lb; soundly beaten off revised rating back at Gowran (9.5f, yielding); eased 1lb and the return to 1m is a plus but needs a career best off this mark.
runners.comment: Up 10lb for impressive Gowran win, beaten off revised mark latest, needs career best

runners.name: Glyndwr
runners.spotlight: Signed off last season with back-to-back 7f AW wins for Ger Lyons; yet to hit form in two runs for this stable and remains a maiden on turf (0-11) but acts on good ground so may improve on his below par effort on soft at Down Royal last time.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form for this yard, 0-11 on turf but soft a valid excuse latest, could improve

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m2f Goodwood novice (gd-fm) last year for James Horton; lost form subsequently but last two runs over 1m at the Curragh (both on good) have been pretty encouraging; well drawn here and can go close if the cheekpieces eke out a little bit more.
runners.comment: Back to form the last twice at the Curragh, can go close if cheekpieces eke out more

runners.name: Frank Pickle
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose best effort in handicaps came over 1m4f at the Curragh last season; this may not be enough of a stamina test.
runners.comment: Maiden, best handicap run came over 1m4f, this trip may be too sharp

runners.name: Finsceal Annie
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner (three on turf) including twice here last season over 7f on good and soft ground; is now just 1lb above the latest of those victories and 1m fine but needs to leave this term's poor form behind.
runners.comment: Two 7f wins here last year, stays 1m but needs to leave this season's poor form behind

runners.name: Dark Summit
runners.spotlight: French winner has failed to fire since joining this stable; handicapper giving him a real chance now but weakened quickly at Ballinrobe last time and others arrive in better form.
runners.comment: Yet to take off for this yard, weakened quickly on latest, others arrive in better form

runners.name: Heart Of Eternity
runners.spotlight: Godolphin cast off has failed to fire in five runs for this yard; beaten 44l in first-time blinkers (discarded) at Naas on latest; hard to fancy on recent showings.
runners.comment: Yet to fire for this yard, blinkers worn last time discarded, hard to fancy on recent form

runners.name: Bill Silvers
runners.spotlight: Best run for this yard came at this venue last season (1m1f, soft); not as good in three subsequent outings and pulled up when last seen at Clonmel in September (blood at both nostrils); best watched on return.
runners.comment: Ran well on soft here last year, pulled up when last seen in Sept', best watched on return

races.race_name: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)

runners.name: Harana
runners.spotlight: Shed the maiden tag at the fourth attempt in a Ballinrobe maiden 17 days ago (9.5f, yielding); previously beaten 9.25l on handicap debut over this C&D (soft) and is now 6lb higher; might prefer a bit of an ease in the ground.
runners.comment: Won Ballinrobe maiden latest, previously beaten in C&D h'cap, may prefer easier ground
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Jamestown
runners.spotlight: Consistent 3yo; AW winner is 0-3 on turf but has yet to finish out of the first three; excellent effort in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, gd-fm) on latest, keeping on for a 1.5l third; just 3lb higher now and should stay this extra furlong; leading claims.
runners.comment: AW winner, fine effort at Royal Ascot latest, just 3lb higher here, leading claims

runners.name: Nakasero
runners.spotlight: AW and two-time turf winner whose last success came over C&D (good) last August off 9lb lower; may have needed latest run over 1m4f here after 105 days off so may take a step forward now dropped back in trip with that run under his belt.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 9lb lower last term, may have needed latest, can improve
runners.owner: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan

runners.name: Thread Of Gold
runners.spotlight: 3yo; Curragh maiden winner (7f, good) last term ran a fine race behind Tim Toe on his seasonal return at Listowel (1m, good) and that rival ran a cracker off 91 in the Ascot Stakes on his next start; this longer trip should suit and he's interesting on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Curragh maiden winner, form of last run boosted, 3yo interesting on handicap debut
runners.owner: Team Valor International LLC & Gary Barber

runners.name: Harmani
runners.spotlight: 3yo; off the mark in emphatic fashion at Down Royal (10.5f, good) in May; hiked up 15lb and came up short back there latest, although 1m5f on soft ground may not have been to his liking; drops back in trip on more suitable ground now and rider claims valuable 5lb; could bounce back.
