runners.comment: 3yo, up 15lb for easy Down Royal win on penultimate, excuses latest, could rebound

runners.name: Anvika
runners.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as record of 1-24 on turf illustrates; however, is now 2lb below that sole success and not beaten far in fillies' handicaps over C&D on penultimate or at Limerick on latest; place chance.
runners.comment: 1-24 on turf, 2lb below only win and ran well over C&D on penultimate, place chance

runners.name: Lord Massusus
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner including Listed and Group 3 races here over 1m on good ground; not a bad effort in first handicap start since 2023 at the Curragh last time (denied a clear run) and eased 1lb for that; goes well here and firmly enters calculations upped in trip.
runners.comment: Listed and Gr'3 1m winner here, not a bad handicap run on latest, enters calculations

runners.name: Playin Cool
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a C&D maiden on heavy last October; beaten a nose off 4lb lower over 7f here (soft) early last month; shifted right under pressure but kept on well for a 4.25l third of 13 in premier handicap at the Curragh last time (1m, good); this longer trip fine and should go well again.
runners.comment: C&D winner on heavy, solid 7f-1m runs the last twice, go well again upped in trip

runners.name: Diego El Queso
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on turf at this venue when last sighted in April (1m2f, yld-sft); 5lb higher now and best turf runs have come on easier ground than this so could probably do with some rain.
runners.comment: Off since breakthrough turf win here in April, up 5lb, might prefer easier ground

runners.name: Retracement
runners.spotlight: Won off 5lb lower at the Curragh last season (1m2f, yielding); not a bad run over that C&D on seasonal return but struggled upped to 1m4f there on latest; eased 1lb, cheekpieces go on and this shorter trip more suitable so not dismissed.
runners.comment: Won over 1m2f last season, 1m4f may have stretched latest, cheekpieces on, drops in trip

runners.name: Slieve Binnian
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner including this race last season off 3lb higher; below best in two runs this term, including in race he won last year at the Curragh on his latest start; capable off this mark but needs to rediscover best.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 3lb higher, soundly beaten both starts this term, revival needed

runners.name: Burford Beauty
runners.spotlight: Best handicap display so far when third over 7f at Down Royal in May; needs to find more
runners.comment: Best handicap display so far when third over 7f at Down Royal, needs to find more

runners.name: Shelbourne Flyer
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 14 starts; one of his better runs last year when second over 7f at this venue; heavily supported in the betting when sixth of 14 at Roscommon (7f, yielding) on yard debut last month; this trip and ground may suit better.
runners.comment: Well backed in a 7f race at Limerick on stable debut, this trip and ground may suit better

runners.name: Slaney Swagger
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden, placed ten times, including five in a good spell between July and October last season; reported coughing at Down Royal on seasonal/stable debut; can do better.
runners.comment: 21-race maiden, placed ten times, reported coughing at Down Royal on return, can do better

runners.name: Not Simple
runners.spotlight: Won Cork handicap (7f, soft) last September; failed to sustain that progress on her last three starts in 2025; improved from her seasonal debut when fifth at Gowran; not one of the more obvious contenders after unplaced Cork run.
runners.comment: Last season's Cork win came over 7f on soft ground, not one of the more obvious contenders

runners.name: Yquem
runners.spotlight: Promise in a couple of AW runs for John O'Donoghue; weaker form in five runs on turf for that yard; stepped up from stable debut when beating Nibras Rainbow over C&D three weeks ago, justifying market confidence; reportedly in foal to Phoenix Of Spain; may continue to prosper.
runners.comment: Well backed when beating Nibras Rainbow over C&D, in-foal mare may cope with 10lb rise

runners.name: Sayfa Fad
runners.spotlight: Has failed to distinguish herself in three starts since beating Nibras Rainbow at Bellewstown last August; towards the rear over 1m at this venue last month.
runners.comment: Has failed to distinguish herself since beating Nibras Rainbow at Bellewstown last August

runners.name: Master Garvey
runners.spotlight: Strike rate of 1-32 on turf; sole success came on heavy ground over 7f at Naas in 2024; fair form at a modest level lately, needs to raise his game in new headgear combination; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, strike rate of 1-33 on turf, sole success on heavy ground over 7f in 2024
runners.owner: Patrick M O'Brien/Larry Murray/Richard W Walsh/Derek Cummins

runners.name: Alto Sax
runners.spotlight: Winner of two of his five starts since April; possibly unsuited by the 1m4f trip at Fairyhouse on latest; this trip is probably closer to his optimum.
runners.comment: Winner of two of his last five starts, possibly unsuited by the 1m4f trip on latest

runners.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Followed a poor effort at Cork with a 33-1 win at Killarney (1m, good) in May, holding on by a short head after making all; backed that up with a C&D third; no match for Yquem over C&D three weeks ago; could struggle to turn the tables on the in-foal winner.
runners.comment: Solid form on her three most recent starts, no match for Yquem over C&D three weeks ago

runners.name: La Campanella
runners.spotlight: Has shown mild promise at Dundalk and has run with some credit in two Fairyhouse handicaps lately; needs to find extra.
runners.comment: Has run with some credit in two Fairyhouse handicaps lately, needs to find  extra

runners.name: Half Nutz
runners.spotlight: Six wins to his name but on a losing run that stretches back to September 2022; not beaten far in two of four visits to Gowran in recent months; Limerick third offered renewed hope, confirmed by a C&D second that gives him a slight edge over William F Browne and Max Meridius.
runners.comment: Second over C&D last month, previous Limerick third also offered grounds for optimism

runners.name: Famous Enough
runners.spotlight: Won a Cork 1m handicap last season off 40 (good) and added an AW win in September; 1-22 record on turf is a negative; 1 1/2l behind La Campanella when fifth at Fairyhouse last time.
runners.comment: 1-22 record on turf is a negative, 1 1/2l behind La Campanella at Fairyhouse last time

runners.name: Milverton
runners.spotlight: Placed in a bumper at Perth in 2024; never in the first four in 13 Flat starts, fair sixth of 12 at Fairyhouse on latest, not far behind La Campanella and Famous Enough.
runners.comment: Placed in a bumper, never in the first four in 13 Flat starts, fair sixth of 12 on latest

runners.name: Medieval Night
runners.spotlight: Second in a 21-runner C&D contest last August when trained by Dermot Weld; ran his best race so far for this stable when third over C&D last month; fair chance if bouncing back from a below-par run at Roscommon last week.
runners.comment: Below-par at Roscommon last week, two career-best displays have been over C&D

runners.name: Shahada Ace
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at Tipperary last summer; has failed to make an impact in four outings this season, needs to show signs of revival.
runners.comment: Has failed to make an impact in four outings this season, reduced mark should help

runners.name: Lady Crossing
runners.spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; in rear on handicap debut at Dundalk; vastly improved when fourth of 13 at 66-1 over 1m at Limerick last month; dam Crossing was a useful performer for this stable; may be on the upgrade.
runners.comment: In rear in handicap debut at Dundalk, vastly improved when fourth over 1m at Limerick

runners.name: Folk Warrior
runners.spotlight: Achieved his best placing when fourth at Down Royal last time; beaten 15l, so needs to improve.
runners.comment: Achieved his best placing when fourth last time, beaten 15l so needs to improve

runners.name: Max Meridius
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a respectable fifth on handicap debut in a 25-runner 1m2f Curragh race on heavy ground; fit from hurdling before beginning new Flat campaign with an encouraging fith at this venue, not far off Half Nutz then; first-time cheeekpieces.
runners.comment: Began the season with an encouraging run at this venue, not far off Half Nutz then

runners.name: Anchors Away
runners.spotlight: Showed promise at Fairyhouse on handicap debut, blotted his record with a poor Naas run; others have more convincing claims.
runners.comment: Showed promise at Fairyhouse on handicap debut, blotted his record with a poor Naas run

runners.name: Morning Approach
runners.spotlight: 1-41 on turf; struggled on the AW throughout winter but showed more when fifth at Roscommon in May; failed to repeat that effort at Gowran; four years since she recorded a 1m victory at this track.
runners.comment: 1-41 record on turf a significant negative, four years since a 1m victory at this track

runners.name: Mullacurry Maid
runners.spotlight: Huge price for all four runs in maidens, some merit in her showing over 7f here on latest; hefty burden for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Huge price for all four runs in maidens, some merit in her showing over 7f here on latest

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins came in 2024; closely matched with Half Nutz and Max Meridius on C&D running on penultimate start; now has something to prove after failing to sustain his challenge at Fairyhouse last week; visor tried now, replacing tongue-tie/cheekpieces.
runners.comment: No success since 2024, closely matched with Half Nutz and Max Meridius on penultimate run

runners.name: Quarry Stone
runners.spotlight: Poor form as a juvenile, ran only twice last year; has returned to his original trainer; no apparent chance.
runners.comment: Poor form as a juvenile, ran only twice last year; has returned to his original trainer

runners.name: Rushford
runners.spotlight: No win since 2022; finished last in two Dundalk runs after a long absence; again in rear at Fairyhouse on return to turf; marginally better there last time; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, finished last in two AW runs after a long absence, weak turf form too

runners.name: Jazz Dreamers
runners.spotlight: Hard to make a case for him on winter AW form at Dundalk; almost three years since the most recent of three turf wins; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, three turf wins, hard to make a case for him on winter AW form at Dundalk
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & Mrs Bernadette Fahey & Seamus Fahey

races.race_name: Hurling For Cancer Research Supported By Centra On July 24th (Q.R.) Race

runners.name: Delta
runners.spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden winner last season (1m4f); cracking run on seasonal return in big field 1m6f handicap at the Curragh in May; latest run over 2m back there disappointing (cheekpieces tried then are discarded) but capable of better, is rated 91 and Patrick Mullins is an eye-catching booking.
runners.comment: Fine run on seasonal return, poor latest but capable of better, eye catching rider booking

runners.name: The Mediator
runners.spotlight: Bumper, hurdles and Flat winner on good and soft ground; soundly beaten in one of these races at Bellewstown on latest; rated 78 and a fair bit to find on the figures here; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in QR race at Bellewstown latest, a bit to find on these terms
runners.owner: Mrs Sheila O'Ryan & John F Doyle & Grant Leon

runners.name: Sirius
runners.spotlight: Won the big QR race at the Galway festival (2m1f, yielding) under this rider in 2024; added the Amateur Riders' Derby at the Curragh last October (1m4f, heavy), again for this jockey; off since and likely using this as a stepping stone towards another crack at the Galway race he won in 2024.
runners.comment: Both Irish wins for this rider inc' at Galway in 2024, likely heading back there again

runners.name: Friary Road
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner; 0-4 on the Flat and rated 74; well beaten on both previous runs over this C&D; looks to be up against it on these terms.
runners.comment: Bumper/hurdles winner, 0-4 on Flat and rated 74, up against it on these terms

runners.name: Catalani
runners.spotlight: Three-time point-to-point winner gained first success under Rules in a maiden hunter chase at Down Royal in May (2m7f, good); now makes Flat debut in what looks a tough race; probably best watched.
runners.comment: Point and hunter chase winner, makes Flat debut in tough race, likely best watched

runners.name: Murat
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in bumpers (2-2) and won a maiden hurdle here in December; made no impression on Flat debut in Down Royal maiden last time out and will need to leave that well behind.
runners.comment: 2-2 in bumpers, won maiden hurdle here in Dec', needs to leave last run behind

races.race_name: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)

runners.name: Angel Sense
runners.spotlight: Placed in all three starts, the latest when third of six at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in May (fourth has won since and fifth horse finished third in the Windsor Castle); tongue-tie now given a go; sets the standard.
runners.comment: Placed in all three starts over 6f/7f in the spring; sets the standard; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Global Success
runners.spotlight: Improved on her first two efforts when beaten a neck and a short head into third of ten over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago, but the winner did nothing for the form at Nottingham a week ago; cheekpieces given a go.
runners.comment: Close third over C&D 16 days ago but the winner has been well beaten since; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Mashooga
runners.spotlight: April foal by Sergei Prokofiev; 19,000gns foal, 27,000gns yearling; dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Psychedelic Funk (7f/7.4f Group 3) and Gale Force Maya (5.5f/6f Listed), is granddaughter of 1m Listed winner; stable's two winning 2yo newcomers last month were both well backed, so a market check is crucial.
runners.comment: Stable's two winning 2yo newcomers last month were both well backed; market crucial

runners.name: Kiss Cam
runners.spotlight: March foal by Nando Parrado; 7,000euros yearling; closely related to 5f winner Messa Concertata (RPR 77), half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Nifty (including AW; 72); dam 1m1f winner (79), half-sister to 7f 2yo Listed winner Tigrilla, out of 1m4f winner; doesn't jump out on pedigree, but stable gets its share of winning 2yo newcomers and this doesn't look a strong race.
runners.comment: Stable gets its share of winning 2yo newcomers and this doesn't look a strong race

runners.name: Bahia Bonita
runners.spotlight: March foal by Time Test; dam 1m winner (RPR 70), half-sister to winners Beshaayir (1m Group 2) and Kaeso (useful 6f-7.5f), out of 6f 2yo/1m Listed winner; market should indicate what is expected on debut.
runners.comment: Market should indicate what is expected on debut

runners.name: Miss You Nights
runners.spotlight: March foal by Bated Breath; half-sister to six winners including Chocoya (6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 102), Chiringuita (6f 2yo/US 7.5f; 93), Gressington (6f-7.4f including 2yo/AW; 91) and Nightsinwhitesatin (1m2f; 87); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (91); stable doesn't have that many winning 2yo newcomers, but her pedigree makes her well worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, but worth monitoring in the market

runners.name: Secret Flite
runners.spotlight: February foal by Without Parole; half-sister to 5f AW winner Thecoffeepoddotco (RPR 78); dam 5.5f/7f winner (75), closely related to winners Dangerous Moonlite (5f 2yo) and Touch Paper (Greek 6f-1m); would be a rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.
runners.comment: Would be a rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard

runners.name: Tzaritza
runners.spotlight: Finished a tailed-off last of nine on her Wetherby debut (5,5f, good to firm) five weeks ago, but she had an excuse as she banged her head at the start; the market suggested better was expected so she's worth monitoring in the market again.
runners.comment: Had an excuse for last month's Wetherby debut; worth monitoring in the market

runners.name: Clear Horizon
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in both starts, finishing just over 2l behind Global Success over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; sponsoring stable won a division of this last year, but that filly was a previous winner.
runners.comment: Out of the frame in both starts, just over 2l behind Global Success over C&D last time

runners.name: Invicta Rose
runners.spotlight: Fourth of 11 on her Salisbury debut (6f, soft) last month, but has regressed in two starts since; may not come into her own until contesting nurseries.
runners.comment: Some ability on her Salisbury debut last month, but has regressed in two starts since

runners.name: Santo
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred, but made little impression when sixth of ten on her Kempton debut (6f, AW; 12-1) in May; needs to step up.
runners.comment: Little impression when sixth of ten on her Kempton debut in May; needs to step up

races.race_name: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)

runners.name: Sugar Yes Please
runners.spotlight: 12-1 when beaten half a length into fourth of ten on her debut over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; the first three had already shown ability (including a previous winner) so she should be hard to beat if stepping up at all from that.
runners.comment: Beaten half a length into fourth of ten on her debut over C&D 16 days ago; hard to beat

runners.name: My Normandie
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in three starts, though her latest sixth of ten at Nottiingham (5f, good) caught the attention of the stewards; still looks more one for nurseries, though.
runners.comment: Out of the frame in three starts; looks more one for nurseries
runners.owner: Gerard A Normand, Anna & Moa Sundstrom

runners.name: Kiss Of Life
runners.spotlight: April foal by Kameko; half-sister to six winners including Thammin (5f/6f including 2yo/AW/UAE dirt Listed; RPR 106), Ajax Tavern (6f/7f AW; 102) and A Taste Of Honey (7f AW including 2yo; 94); dam 5f-7f winner (including AW/Greece; 69); stable's 2yo newcomers often better for a run, but her pedigree makes her worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Stable's 2yo newcomers often better for a run, but pedigree makes her worth a market check

runners.name: Celestial Mist
runners.spotlight: Finished a very long way behind Sugar Yes Please when last of ten on her debut over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; needs to be a completely different proposition today.
runners.comment: Finished a very long way behind Sugar Yes Please on her debut over C&D 16 days ago

runners.name: So Tempting
runners.spotlight: Comfortably held in her first two starts, the latest over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; nurseries may be more suitable after this.
runners.comment: Comfortably held in her first two starts; nurseries may be more suitable after this

runners.name: Cubbie's Dream
runners.spotlight: April foal by Caturra; half-sister to winners Ibn Aldar (6f/7f AW including 2yo; RPR 80) and Lieutenant Sir (6f; 59); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (78), half-sister to Italian 1m Listed winner Key Master, out of 5f 2yo winner; worth a market check given the stable sponsors the race, but the yard has few winning 2yo newcomers.
runners.comment: Stable has few winning 2yo newcomers

runners.name: Laylaty
runners.spotlight: Gradually got the hang of things when fourth of nine on her Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW; 22-1) last month (winner has followed up impressively since); dam's side of pedigree is all about stamina, but still a player in this field granted normal improvement.
runners.comment: Caught the eye when fourth on her Wolverhampton debut; a player granted normal improvement

runners.name: Ouragan
runners.spotlight: 11-1 when fifth of nine on her Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW) last month, finishing a length behind Laylaty; improvement possible, but it will be needed.
runners.comment: Finished a length behind Laylaty on last month's Wolverhampton debut; improvement needed

runners.name: Princess Ivy
runners.spotlight: 14-1 when last of nine on last month's Sandown debut (5f, good); will need to step up a fair amount in order to figure.
runners.comment: Last of nine on last month's Sandown debut; will need to  step up a fair amount to figure

runners.name: Ennerdale Water
runners.spotlight: 9-1 when last of nine on her Bath debut (5.7f, firm) in May; hood worn then now dispensed with, but major improvement is required.
runners.comment: Last of nine on her Bath debut in May; major improvement is required

races.race_name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Desert Legend
runners.spotlight: Showed good pace when third of 11 on his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) ten days ago; any improvement on that will put him right in the mix; stable also runs the newcomer Old Oak.
runners.comment: Finished third of 11 on his Windsor debut ten days ago; right in the mix

runners.name: Minster Boy
runners.spotlight: Took a long time to realise what was required on last month's Windsor debut (5f, good to firm), having blown the start and run green, but he stayed on in taking style, only just failing to grab third; should be wiser this time and the extra furlong shouldn't be a problem; much respected.
runners.comment: Caught the eye when fourth of 13 on last month's Windsor debut; should be wiser this time

runners.name: My Boo Boo
runners.spotlight: 8-1 when finishing a clear second of ten on his Windsor debut (5f, good) last month; the winner has since been well beaten in the Queen Mary, but the extra furlong ought to suit on breeding and he is high on the list.
runners.comment: Second of ten on his Windsor debut last month; extra furlong ought to suit; high on list

runners.name: Old Oak
runners.spotlight: March foal by State Of Rest; 42,000euros yearling; half-brother to US 1m1f turf winner Centuria; dam French 1m4f winner, half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Stunning Spirit, out of 1m4f winning sister to Fillies' Mile winner Rainbow View; stable looks to hold stronger claims with Desert Legend, but still worth a market check.
runners.comment: Stable looks to hold stronger claims elsewhere, but still worth a market check

runners.name: Wolf Bay
runners.spotlight: March foal by Lope Y Fernandez; half-brother to winners Dunkerron (6f 2yo; RPR 106), Outgun (1m4f AW; 80), Outperform (Japanese 6f including 2yo) and Parmenter (German 1m3f-12.5f); dam placed 7f-1m2f (71), half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Campo Catino; stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, but his pedigree makes him worth a market check.
runners.comment: Stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers but pedigree makes him worth a market check

runners.name: Aljoon
runners.spotlight: April foal by Calyx; 5,000gns breeze-up 2yo; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 76), closely related to 1m2f Flat/2m hurdle winner Cleopatra's Needle, half-sister to useful winners Historic Find (1m 2yo) and Philosopher (7.5f-8.5f); stable has the occasional winning 2yo newcomer, but he's probably only of interest if attracting support.
runners.comment: Probably only of interest if attracting support on debut

runners.name: Beresford Gap
runners.spotlight: 28-1 when sixth of 11 on his Salisbury debut (6f, soft) last month; will need to improve to take this.
runners.comment: Sixth of 11 on his Salisbury debut; will need to improve to take this

runners.name: Gambling Man
runners.spotlight: February foal by Cotai Glory; 20,000euros yearling; 26,000gns breeze-up 2yo; brother to 5f-1m winner Chimgan (including 2yo/Bahrain; RPR 102), half-brother to 1m 2yo winner The Road Is Long (73); dam placed 5.7f turf/7f AW (74), sister to winners Lynn Britt Cabin (7f) and La La Land (8.6f 2yo); stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers.
runners.comment: Stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers

runners.name: God Of Titans
runners.spotlight: April foal by Persian Force; 20,000euros foal; 17,000euros yearling; £8,500 breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to four winners including Lorna Cole (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 77), Sergeant Mayer (5f/6f; 74) and Redshore City (6f; 71); dam 1m-2m4f maiden (57), sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Hatta Fort; already gelded and would be a surprise winner on debut.
runners.comment: Already gelded and would be a surprise winner on debut

runners.name: Silent Sadhu
runners.spotlight: March foal by Sergei Prokofiev; 3,000gns yearling; first foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Navajo Chief (1m Listed) and Imphal (1m5f-2m Flat and 3m-3m2f hurdle), out of unraced half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Mus-If; only of interest if attracting support.
runners.comment: Only of interest if attracting support

runners.name: Banged Up
runners.spotlight: January foal by Without Parole; 20,000gns yearling; half-brother to seven winners including King Cole (5f AW 2yo; RPR 86), Fifteenthamendment (1m2f; 81), Atomic Blonde (US 7.5f turf stakes) and Noble Miss (bumper); dam French 1m-10.5f winner (95); yard often gets them ready first time, but he's already gelded and stable looks to hold much stronger claims with Minster Boy.
runners.comment: Yard can get them ready first time but stable looks to hold stronger claims elsewhere

runners.name: Webster
runners.spotlight: January foal by Kodi Bear; 2,500gns yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners First Folio (Listed-placed 6f), The Actor (5f 2yo) and Artistic Mission (German 6f-1m1f), out of 1m2f winner; stable does have winning 2yo newcomers and has been going well lately; would like to see market support before getting involved, though.
runners.comment: Stable going well lately; would like to see market support before getting involved, though

runners.name: Ard As A Rock
runners.spotlight: April foal by Ardad; 13,000gns yearling, £23,000 2yo; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Walk Of Stars (UAE 9.5f Group 1) and Moon Shimmer (French 1m5f), out of Listed-placed 7f-1m4f winning half-sister to UAE 2m Group 3 winner Whispering Gallery; stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, though did have one go in at 33-1 at Wolverhampton last month.
runners.comment: Stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, though had one at 33-1 last month

runners.name: Macau
runners.spotlight: Sent off 4-1 and showed some ability when third of ten on last month's Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW); likely he will need a lot more in order to take this, though.
runners.comment: Third of ten on last month's Wolverhampton debut, but likely he will need a lot more

runners.name: Zambezi Shark
runners.spotlight: Nice pedigree, but made little impression when fifth of nine on last month's Chester debut (6f, good to soft; 14-1); may need more time.
runners.comment: Little impression when fifth of nine on last month's Chester debut; may need more time
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Ten Of Clubs
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held in two starts over this trip at Wolverhampton (AW) and Salisbury (good to firm) last month; nurseries may be more suitable.
runners.comment: Well held in two starts over this trip last month; nurseries may be more suitable

runners.name: Its A Ginger Thing
runners.spotlight: 25-1 when eighth of 11 on his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) ten days ago, finishing over 4l behind Desert Legend; much more needed.
runners.comment: Eighth of 11 on his Windsor debut ten days ago; much more needed
runners.owner: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner

runners.name: Mirzimaan
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred, but failed to beat a rival on his Newmarket debut (6f, good; 16-1) in May; will need a transformation.
runners.comment: Nicely bred, but failed to beat a rival on his Newmarket debut in May

runners.name: Strike
runners.spotlight: 8yo whose losing run goes back 18 races to July 2024 but he's often run well in the meantime, including on his last two starts; each-way player.
runners.comment: Losing run goes back 18 races to July 2024 but he's often run well in the meantime
runners.owner: S Emmet And Miss R Emmet

runners.name: Black Endeavour
runners.spotlight: 3yo who has worked his way back into form this term and posted a good third at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) in May before winning there (6f, good to firm) last month from one who won next time out; also effective elsewhere; respected up 4lb.
runners.comment: 3yo who won at Doncaster last month and the form has been franked; respected up 4lb

runners.name: Campenaerts
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who won two nurseries last year and is below his last winning mark; Windsor last month was a step back in the right direction but he needs another today if he's to be a serious force.
runners.comment: Windsor last month was a step back in the right direction but he needs another today

runners.name: Wyle Cop
runners.spotlight: 3yo who returned to form when third in first-time blinkers at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month, a performance that can be marked up as he had a wide trip; also effective on turf and he's a major player if the blinkers maintain a positive effect.
runners.comment: Third on AW last month and a major player if the blinkers maintain a positive effect

runners.name: The Feminine Urge
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when 4l seventh of 13 at Windsor (5f, good to firm) ten days ago and she has another career-low mark this evening; however, she hasn't been threatening of late and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Another career-low mark this evening but she hasn't been threatening of late

runners.name: Nzuri
runners.spotlight: Bumped into smart prospect when 6l second at 150-1 in Kempton maiden (6f, AW) in May on third start for Jack Channon, but down the field in two handicaps since (6f, good/AW); may be best watched on stable debut; remains in same ownership.
runners.comment: Promise in AW maiden in May but down the field in two handicaps since; stable debut

runners.name: Rebel Path
runners.spotlight: Merely mid-division at Newmarket (6f, good) three weeks ago but prior to that he took a step back in the right direction when third on the Rowley Mile there (6f, good) and his stable is in fine form; not discounted.
runners.comment: Merely mid-division last time but he was third previously and his stable is in fine form

runners.name: Roman Spring
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent this season but he won three times last year and returned to form when third over C&D (good to firm) recently; another 1lb lower today and can be in the mix if backing up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Returned to form when third over C&D recently and can be in the mix if backing that up

runners.name: Jimmy Knocker
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed good spell of form over 6f last summer and the drop back in trip may help, but he hasn't shaped this year as though a win is imminent.
runners.comment: The drop back in trip may help but he hasn't shaped this year as though a win is imminent

runners.name: Arabian Cobra
runners.spotlight: Very well handicapped on last summer's exploits but he's been a long way below that level this year and a major turnaround is needed.
runners.comment: Very well handicapped on last summer's exploits but a long way below that level this year

runners.name: Thunderous Love
runners.spotlight: Hard to fancy on recent evidence whereas she arrived in good form prior to winning this last year (good to firm); however, she's dropped to a dangerous mark and can't be written off in her bid to make it 2-2 here.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy on recent evidence but won this last year and can't be written off

runners.name: The Coffee Pod
runners.spotlight: He's on a reduced mark and his yard is going well; however, he had a patchy campaign last season and was soundly beaten in April on his sole run this year (pulled hard on that stable debut); others have less to prove.
runners.comment: He's on a reduced mark and his yard is going well but others arrive with less to prove

races.race_name: Pump Technology Engineered To Perform Handicap

runners.name: Storm Point
runners.spotlight: 2-3 since handicapping, his latest success coming on his turf debut over C&D (good to soft) four weeks ago; 5lb higher and will likely face different conditions this time, but he remains open to further improvent; respected.
runners.comment: 5lb higher than when making a successful turf debut over C&D last month; respected

runners.name: Signcastle City
runners.spotlight: Holds his form well and wasn't beaten far into fifth of 13 here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago (Nakaaha 3l behind in sixth); has won twice over this trip, but a suspicion that 7f suits him best.
runners.comment: Holds his form well; has won twice over this trip, but a suspicion that 7f suits him best

runners.name: The Third Star
runners.spotlight: Sole win came on the AW and is 0-6 on turf, but she ran well when chasing home an in-form rival over C&D (good to firm) last month; a player from the same mark.
runners.comment: Chased home an in-form rival over C&D last month; a player from the same mark

runners.name: Grizedale
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at Kempton (1m, AW), the latest a week ago; just 1lb wrong under his 5lb penalty and he remains unexposed, but fast ground is an unknown (best turf run on soft); stable also runs Distinct Spirit.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner at Kempton; fast ground is an unknown with his best turf run on soft

runners.name: The Dragon King
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form when second of seven at Salisbury (7f, good) last month; 1lb rise for that still leaves him 1lb below his last winning mark and he ran well in his only previous attempt over this far; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 1lb below his last winning mark and he ran well in his only previous attempt over this far

runners.name: Nakaaha
runners.spotlight: Two wins last summer, including one over C&D, and got back to winning ways at Bath (1m, firm) eight days ago; was already due a 2lb drop then so is just 3lb higher under her penalty (1lb well in); one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: C&D winner and scored at Bath last time; only 3lb higher; one for the shortlist

runners.name: Mythical Bird
runners.spotlight: Went up 8lb for for her emphatic success at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in April; ran with credit when third of six at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) the following month, but well beaten at Sandown (1m2f, good) last time; only 2lb lower and probably needs further than this now.
runners.comment: Probably needs further than this now and still looks on a stiff mark

runners.name: Captain Fox
runners.spotlight: May not have achieved that much when justifying odds of 1-2 in a Lingfield novice (1m, AW; first start since being gelded) in February and was well beaten on handicap debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in April; this is only his second start on turf, but other look more compelling.
runners.comment: 1-5; this is only his second start on turf, but other look more compelling

runners.name: Chale Chalo
runners.spotlight: Turf maiden winner who did well on the AW during the winter, but well held on his return from six months off at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago; something to prove tackling this far for the first time.
runners.comment: Well held on last month's reappearance; tackles this far for the first time

runners.name: Sea Founder
runners.spotlight: Two wins this year came on the AW, but his sole turf win came over this trip on good to firm ground; may be best to forgive his latest Chester performance and a possible if back on song.
runners.comment: Sole turf win came over this trip on good to firm ground; a possible if back on song

runners.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners.spotlight: Last five wins have come on the AW including when completing a hat-trick in the spring; has winning form on good to firm ground, but his last two efforts since returning to turf need improving upon.
runners.comment: Has winning form on good to firm ground, but last two efforts need improving upon

runners.name: Distinct Spirit
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since making a winning debut at Salisbury (7f, good) two years ago; returns from another nine months off and the market may provide clues.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; returns from another nine months off and the market may provide clues

races.race_name: Pump Technology Services Keeping You Flowing Handicap

runners.name: Windbreaker
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt who shaped well when a head second of ten in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap 11 days ago, nearest finish having been slowly away and challenged wide; cheekpieces go on now; player off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Shaped well when beaten head at Wolverhampton latest; cheekpieces on; player off same mark

runners.name: Astracornus
runners.spotlight: Much improved on his first go in handicap company when emphatically landing five-runner event at Nottingham (1m2f) 19 days ago; up 6lb but runner-up has gone in since and he holds major claims with better to come.
runners.comment: Much improved when emphatic Nottingham winner; holds major claims with better to come

runners.name: Magician Of Riga
runners.spotlight: Improved to land handicaps at Wolverhampton (1m4f) and Southwell (1m3f) in April; posted another good effort when a staying-on third of ten at Wolverhampton (9.5f) 11 days ago; must enter calculations with this return to further also a plus.
runners.comment: Good third at Wolverhampton 11 days ago; must enter calculations back up in trip

runners.name: Turtle Reef
runners.spotlight: Raced very freely but still posted his best effort when third of seven on his handicap debut/return at Doncaster (1m2f) last month; he can progress further, especially if settling better.
runners.comment: Free but best effort when third at Doncaster; can progress, especially if settling better

runners.name: Queen's Companion
runners.spotlight: Fair form when placed on her first three starts at 7f/1m; not discredited in first-time cheekpieces with fifth of 11 on her handicap debut at Sandown (1m) last month; more is needed over this longer trip if she's to gain a first win.
runners.comment: Not discredited with fifth at Sandown latest; more is needed over this  longer trip
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Norman Invasion
runners.spotlight: Fair form shown when twice placed over 1m; hood refitted when a respectable sixth of eight on his handicap debut at Chester (7.5f) last month; this son of Lope De Vega needs this step up in trip to spark improvement.
runners.comment: Respectable sixth at Chester last month; needs this step up in trip to spark improvement

runners.name: Raintown
runners.spotlight: Scored over 1m4f here last July; winless since but comes here on the back of a good second of nine in 1m3f handicap here 16 days ago so can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Good second of nine in 1m3f handicap here 16 days ago so can't be ruled out
runners.owner: Ms Caroline Instone & J S Moore

runners.name: Two Plus Two
runners.spotlight: Made all for his last three wins, the latest at Bath in May; never better than when beaten a nose in four-runner race at Nottingham (again 1m6f on good to firm) two weeks ago, so he needs respect.
runners.comment: Made all for last three wins, the latest at Bath in May; never better than on latest start

runners.name: Lusaka
runners.spotlight: Latest of his six wins was in clearcut style in this race last year (good to firm) off 1lb higher, making all; running creditably back on turf this season and looks set for a bold show, but all of today's rivals are either in good form too and/or far less exposed.
runners.comment: Latest win came in this race last year off 1lb higher, making all; running creditably

runners.name: Barrister
runners.spotlight: Unraced on firmer than good; showed ability on all four starts, including in demanding company on first two this season; 8l third of seven on handicap debut here (1m4f, good to soft; 7-1) on latest outing, shaping as if he'd be suited by further; unexposed but improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Third on handicap debut here (1m4f); this new trip could suit but improvement is needed

runners.name: Aukus
runners.spotlight: Some ability in second and third races but tailed off on starts either side, the latest on handicap debut at Goodwood (1m4f, good; 22-1) behind La Peregrina; the blinkers worn on last three outings are now replaced by a visor.
runners.comment: Some ability twice but tailed off on handicap debut at Goodwood behind La Peregrina

runners.name: Kakirra
runners.spotlight: Vastly improved on the transition to handicapping with two wins at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and one in between at Bath (1m2f, firm); used varied tactics; got the better of a sustained duel last time and then hung on narrowly from two stronger finishers; another 3lb higher today but this trip is plausible and so is further improvement.
runners.comment: 3-3 in handicaps; another 3lb higher but new trip is plausible, as is further improvement

runners.name: La Peregrina
runners.spotlight: A very different proposition when upped to 1m4f at Goodwood (good; unraced on firmer) three weeks ago in his second handicap, coming from off the pace and passing the post in front by a short head but demoted for interference (edged left); up 3lb but may well have more to give, including at new trip.
runners.comment: Demoted when narrowly first past the post at Goodwood (upped to 1m4f, good) last time

runners.name: Celestarak
runners.spotlight: Left inauspicious seasonal/handicap debut (1m2f) behind when very close second (subsequently awarded race) at Goodwood (1m4f, good) last month, reportedly benefiting from combination of step up in trip and first-time hood; could easily have more improvement to come.
runners.comment: Improved form when close second (awarded race) at Goodwood last month, his second handicap

runners.name: Darkest Red
runners.spotlight: A maiden after nine starts but close second three consecutive times (1m2f-11.5f) since upped to middle-distance trips in April; proven on fast ground and seems very likely to be in the shake-up again.
runners.comment: 0-9 but has gone close three consecutive times since upped to middle-distance trips

runners.name: Society Girl
runners.spotlight: Stumbled soon after the start and did not get competitive when upped to 11.4f for handicap debut at Windsor (good to firm) in May but was made favourite for that race and probably still has potential.
runners.comment: Flopped when favourite for handicap debut in May but probably still has potential

runners.name: Tai Hang Pegasus
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; faded into sixth of nine on seasonal debut at Lingfield (1m2f, good) three weeks ago but significant positives can be drawn from that outing and he might come on for the run; tries a new trip.
runners.comment: 0-6 but ran well to a point over 1m2f on seasonal debut; tries a new trip here

runners.name: Zurna
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who appeared to take a big step forward when 66-1 second of four behind 1-3 favourite in Newmarket novice (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; it's tricky to weigh up what that form is worth, though, and he probably needs to improve again on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Appeared to show improvement when 66-1 second of four in recent Newmarket novice

races.race_name: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.name: Eabha
runners.spotlight: Well held when third of six at 1-3 odds at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) last month but made promising debut when placed behind the subsequent close Chesham third at Newbury (6f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier and is back on fast ground here; must be considered.
runners.comment: Disappointed at short odds last time but can still build upon promising Newbury debut

runners.name: Minnal
runners.spotlight: Out of an unraced half-sister to a Listed winner; slowly away but kept on from the rear for promising sixth of 13 in quite valuable Doncaster maiden (7f, good to firm) last month; should improve; likely contender.
runners.comment: Kept on from the rear for promising sixth in quite valuable Doncaster maiden; big player

runners.name: Tiora Time
runners.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 6f AW winner Tantomile (RPR 55); dam 7f-1m3f winner (84), half-sister to winners Afta Party (1m Flat/hurdle) and Line House (7f including 2yo); market may guide.
runners.comment: 16,000gns yearing; dam 7f-1m3f winner (RPR 84); market may guide

runners.name: Aminaty
runners.spotlight: With a good stable but was towards rear throughout and finished behind Minnal on recent debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm).
runners.comment: With a good stable but was towards rear throughout on her recent debut at Doncaster

runners.name: Chaise Longue
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to a Norwegian 7f 2yo winner; dam lightly raced half-sister to winners Nyaleti (1m Group 2), Sir Patrick Moore (Australian 6f Group 2) and Alsakib (1m6f Group 3); stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners.
runners.comment: Half-sister to a Norwegian 7f 2yo winner; yard not prolific with newcomers

runners.name: Woodhay Wayfarer
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when respectable fifth of nine at Kempton (7f, AW) last month; needs further progress on this turf return but still considered each-way.
runners.comment: Respectable fifth at Kempton (7f, AW) last month, her second run; considered each-way

runners.name: Pearl Grace
runners.spotlight: Out of Irish 1,000 Guineas/Yorkshire Oaks winner Pleascach; looked in need of the experience and was never dangerous on last month's debut at Pontefract (6f, good) but made encouraging late headway and could be a different proposition over this longer trip and with that run in the bank.
runners.comment: Made late headway over 7f on debut and can improve over this longer trip

runners.name: Crown Velocity
runners.spotlight: Out of an unraced half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Dandhu; showed only minor promise when eighth of 13 at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and needs to have learned from that experience.
runners.comment: Showed only minor promise when eighth of 13 at Yarmouth (6f) a fortnight ago

runners.name: Summer Triangle
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Armor; well down the field when 80-1 for debut at Ascot (5f, good) two months ago; considered only if much stronger in the betting.
runners.comment: Well down the field when 80-1 for debut at Ascot (5f) two months ago

runners.name: Silver Trumpet
runners.spotlight: Didn't fire on Tapeta three weeks ago but began this campaign with three respectable runs and is now only 3lb higher than when winning easily by nearly 5l over C&D (good) last summer; dangerous to ignore.
runners.comment: C&D winner in 2025; didn't fire last time but first three runs this year were respectable

runners.name: Jersey Maverick
runners.spotlight: Has modest 1-17 strike-rate but he's pretty consistent and his win was gained over C&D on good to firm ground (just under a year ago); finished well for second at Leicester (6f, good) last month and this step back up in trip is an obvious move; high on the list.
runners.comment: Has modest 1-17 strike-rate but he's pretty consistent and his win was gained over C&D
runners.owner: Tim Cottier, Clark, Spence And Fellowes

runners.name: Dandy Khan
runners.spotlight: Won five times at Lingfield (7f-1m) during the last AW season and was still in good form there when last seen in April; has 0-12 strike-rate on turf, though, and others in this line-up look better handicapped.
runners.comment: Won five times during last AW season but is 0-12 on turf; returns from a break

runners.name: Potomac River
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden; struggled on soft ground on seasonal/handicap debut but shaped with significant promise before fading into seventh at Newmarket (7f, good) three weeks ago and will appreciate this ease in grade.
runners.comment: 0-5 but shaped with significant promise in better race than this at Newmarket last month

runners.name: Stenmark
runners.spotlight: Close third on stable debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) in May and didn't run badly when close eighth of ten (just behind Potomac River) in stronger race than this at Newmarket (7f, good) three weeks ago; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Close third on stable debut in May and didn't run badly at Newmarket last time

runners.name: Panelli
runners.spotlight: Began year in good form on AW, losing out only by a head at Chelmsford (7f) on latest outing in February; still on a workable mark and should be fine back on turf; contender if tuned up after his break.
runners.comment: Began year in good form on AW; contender if tuned up after five-month break

runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but won off 2lb higher at Catterick (6f, good) in April and beat his group when fifth overall in 14-runner Ayr handicap (6f, soft) last month; also suited by fast ground; can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Scored off 2lb higher in April and won his group when fifth overall at Ayr last month

runners.name: Rage Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Back in prime form at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month, coming from the rear to win cosily under a confident ride; quickly back up to career-high mark but still commands respect.
runners.comment: Came from the rear to win cosily under confident ride at Newbury last month; respected
runners.owner: B D Haynes, G L Moore, Alan Jamieson

runners.name: Acclaimed Freedom
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who went close when dropped back to 6f at Windsor (6f, good to soft) last month and also ran well when fourth at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on Saturday; might be better by a stiffer 6f than this but could have a say if aided by refitted cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Two good runs since dropped back to 6f; can feature if aided by refitted cheekpieces
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Harry Brown
runners.spotlight: Scored at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) in May and probably bettered that performance when very close second at Brighton (5.2f, good to firm) last month; recent Windsor run is best overlooked (saddle slipped); slightly out of the weights but the return to 6f won't be a problem; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: In good form over 5f lately and this return to 6f won't be a problem; in the mix again
runners.owner: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd

runners.name: Balon d'Or
runners.spotlight: 0-6 on AW for new stable since the autumn but took good step back in right direction when close fourth at Lingfield (5f) last month and will be suited by this return to 6f on turf; interesting.
runners.comment: Step back in right direction over 5f on AW last month; this return to 6f on turf will suit

runners.name: King Of Chaos
runners.spotlight: Exploited reduced mark with clearcut win at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; evidently in good nick but went back up 6lb for that and this return to turf may not be ideal.
runners.comment: Went back up 6lb for last month's clearcut AW win; this return to turf may not be ideal

runners.name: Twirler
runners.spotlight: Has a point to prove after running poorly in recent Newbury race won by Rage Of Thunder but was in good form beforehand, most notably when winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm); contender if quickly back on song.
runners.comment: Ran poorly 16 days ago but was in good form beforehand; contender if quickly back on song

runners.name: Ancient Times
runners.spotlight: Has a C&D win (in 2021) on his CV but ended last year in poor form and made a low-key reappearance last month; needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: Ended last year in poor form and made a low-key reappearance last month

runners.name: Swiped
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who was evidently well suited by the step up in trip when winning readily at Bath (1m, good) last month; found one too good when odds-on to follow up there (firm) last week but was clear of the others and remains of strong interest; swaps blinkers for first-time visor.
runners.comment: Ready winner when upped to 1m last month and has run well in defeat since

runners.name: Ritaal
runners.spotlight: 0-5 on AW; got going too late when never-dangerous fourth from the rear at Lingfield (7f; first-time cheekpieces) last month but that was her first run since January and this longer trip might suit better on her turf debut; blinkers and a tongue-tie are tried this time.
runners.comment: Got going too late over 7f on AW last month; this trip may suit better on turf debut

runners.name: Play Me
runners.spotlight: Consistent 4yo who won over C&D (good) last summer and came from off the pace to double his tally at Brighton (1m, good) last month; probably doesn't have much margin for error off new mark but ought to be on the premises.
runners.comment: Consistent 4yo; won over C&D last summer and doubled his tally at Brighton last month
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Darvel
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with second in amateur riders' race at Brighton (1m, good to firm) last month and is still on a good mark but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon, and his habit of starting slowly is another worry.
runners.comment: Returned to form at Brighton last month but is far too inconsistent to rely upon

runners.name: Buy The Dip
runners.spotlight: Looked as good as ever when winning at Lingfield (1m, AW) on seasonal debut in April and again ran well over that C&D last month; didn't fire when back on turf recently (restless in stalls) but has form at this track and enters calculations.
runners.comment: AW winner in April; didn't fire on recent turf return but has form here; a possible

runners.name: Happy Banner
runners.spotlight: Three good runs this season, the latest a second at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; competes off same mark and will be a tough nut to crack if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.
runners.comment: Three good runs this season; big player if new cheekpieces have any positive effect

runners.name: Prodigal Son
runners.spotlight: Came good in first-time blinkers at Bath (1m, firm) in April, after a break, but managed only third in a small field there (1m2f) in May and was soundly beaten on his latest outing; needs to kick on again.
runners.comment: Won in first-time blinkers in April, after a break, but soundly beaten on latest outing

runners.name: Tronido
runners.spotlight: Gained this season's win at Lingfield (7f, good), where she was allowed to dominate against the favoured nearside rail; also suited but this C&D but ran poorly on Polytrack ten days ago and would appeal more on slower ground.
runners.comment: Suited by this C&D but ran poorly on AW recently and would appeal more on slower ground

runners.name: Takeitorleaveit
runners.spotlight: Scored at Bath (1m, firm) on seasonal debut in April and comes here after chasing home next-time-out winners on consecutive outings last month (1m1f/1m); major player if suited by this new trip.
runners.comment: Second to next-time-out winners on both starts last month; major player if new trip suits

runners.name: Sail On Sailor
runners.spotlight: Progressive for new stable this season and bids to complete a hat-trick after 1m wins at Bath (good) and Lingfield (AW); his tendency to race too freely remains a nagging concern but he could plausibly have more improvement to come over this new trip; obvious contender.
runners.comment: Progressive for new stable this season and bids to complete a hat-trick after two 1m wins

runners.name: Living In Hope
runners.spotlight: Finished last on both 2yo starts but her big-odds fourth of seven at Goodwood (1m, good to soft) last month was much more encouraging and further progress is possible in handicaps.
runners.comment: Finished last on both 2yo starts but last month's Goodwood fourth was much better

runners.name: Cormorant Rock
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise when a big-priced outsider for three novice races this spring (7.6f-1m2f); makes handicap debut from a basement mark but significant improvement is required.
runners.comment: Makes handicap debut from a basement mark but significant improvement is required

runners.name: Don Pablo Colina
runners.spotlight: Struggled in soft-ground maiden last month (7.6f) but displayed some promise when midfield on both AW starts in May (1m/7f), and his pedigree suggests he'll be suited by the new trip on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Struggled on soft ground last month but showed some promise on AW in May; handicap debut

runners.name: Sweep In Time
runners.spotlight: Not beaten that far in three AW novice/maiden races (7f-1m) towards end of last year and remains unexposed but this handicap/turf debut comes after a 190-day absence; has showed a tendency to race too freely; hood removed after one use.
runners.comment: Not beaten that far in her three qualifying runs but makes handicap debut after a layoff

runners.name: Minerality
runners.spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow in three novice/maiden races this spring (1m-8.6f) but has more realistic chance to get competitive in this run-of-the-mill handicap; market may guide.
runners.comment: Unable to land a telling blow in three novice/maiden races; might fare better in handicaps
